raw.title: Director of Contact Strategy Platforms
raw.excerpt: Our StoryTopDog Law is not your typical law firm.
raw.description:
Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.

We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

The Opportunity

TopDog Law is building a modern contact strategy operation, and Genesys Cloud is becoming one of the most important platforms behind how prospective clients, current clients, and our teams connect. We are looking for a Director of Contact Strategy Platforms who can build the team, operating discipline, and technical execution required to make Genesys a reliable, scalable, high-performing part of the business.

This is a build-and-lead role for someone who is equally comfortable setting standards, developing technical talent, and getting hands-on in the platform. You will lead our Genesys Administrators/Engineers while remaining close enough to the work to design, troubleshoot, review, and help deliver complex solutions across routing, outbound dialing, telephony, integrations, recording, digital channels, automation, and AI.

The VP of Contact Strategy will set the business priorities, target outcomes, and Genesys technical roadmap. Your job is to turn that direction into an executable plan, lead the team responsible for delivery, own the day-to-day health and governance of the platform, and make sure Genesys consistently delivers the capabilities and performance the business expects. This is a business-owned platform function that will operate in close partnership with IT, Salesforce, Data Engineering, Legal, Operations, and our external technology partners.

What You Will Own

Build and Lead the Genesys Function

  • Build, lead, and develop the Genesys Administrators/Engineers responsible for the day-to-day administration, engineering, support, and enhancement of the platform.
  • Create clear ownership, operating rhythms, technical standards, documentation expectations, and escalation paths so the team can move quickly without sacrificing quality or control.
  • Be hands-on in Genesys Cloud. Review and contribute to complex configuration, Architect flows, routing strategies, outbound solutions, integrations, and technical troubleshooting when the situation requires it.
  • Assess the skills, capacity, and coverage required to support the platform as TopDog Law grows, and recommend the right future team structure based on actual business demand and technical complexity.
  • Develop technical bench strength, cross-training, and succession coverage so critical platform knowledge is not concentrated with any one person.

Turn the Roadmap Into Delivery

  • Translate the Genesys roadmap and priorities established by the VP of Contact Strategy into clear implementation plans with owners, dependencies, milestones, testing requirements, and measurable outcomes.
  • Coordinate releases and major changes across business teams, IT, Salesforce, Filevine, Data Engineering, carriers, Genesys, and implementation partners.
  • Make sure new capabilities are not simply deployed, but tested, documented, communicated, adopted, and measured against the intended business outcome.

Own the Platform Day to Day

  • Own the reliability, stability, performance, and operational health of Genesys Cloud across the organization.
  • Oversee and continuously improve Architect flows, IVR logic, queues, skills, routing, priorities, overflow strategies, callbacks, outbound campaigns, dialing strategies, digital channels, recording, and other platform configurations.
  • Maintain clear, current documentation for critical flows, integrations, policies, configurations, dependencies, and support procedures.
  • Establish proactive platform-health reviews and identify risks, recurring defects, capacity constraints, or configuration issues before they materially impact employees or clients.

Lead Incidents, Change, and Problem Management

  • Serve as the senior owner for major Genesys incidents and recurring platform problems, ensuring the right teams are engaged and the issue is driven to resolution end to end.
  • Establish practical change-management, testing, approval, deployment, rollback, and post-release validation standards for production changes.
  • Review Genesys releases and feature changes, determine business impact, and coordinate testing, communication, or configuration updates when needed.
  • Create clear escalation paths and accountability with Genesys, telecommunications carriers, implementation partners, Salesforce teams, and other vendors involved in the platform.

Connect Genesys to the Rest of the Business

  • Own the Genesys side of integrations with Salesforce, Filevine, data platforms, telecommunications carriers, messaging providers, and other enterprise systems.
  • Lead the design and support of data actions, APIs, webhooks, screen pops, workflow automations, data lookups, synchronization processes, and other cross-platform capabilities.
  • Make ownership across Contact Strategy, IT, vendors, and business teams explicit so cross-system issues do not stall because responsibility is unclear.

Drive Business Performance and Client Experience

  • Partner with Intake, Client Success, Workforce Management, Quality Assurance, Learning & Development, Analytics, Legal, and other teams to turn operational problems into effective Genesys solutions.
  • Use the platform to improve the metrics that matter to the business, including speed to lead, answer rate, contact rate, outbound productivity, abandonment, callback completion, transfer success, conversion, and employee productivity.
  • Improve the client experience by making it easier to reach TopDog Law, get to the right person, receive timely callbacks, and move through interactions with fewer unnecessary transfers or delays.
  • Identify and implement high-value opportunities involving live transcription, call summaries, Agent Assist, AI routing, speech and text analytics, automated wrap-up, workflow automation, and other Genesys capabilities.

Protect the Business Through Strong Governance

  • Translate approved Legal and Compliance requirements into reliable platform controls related to calling hours, consent, call recording, data retention, do-not-call processes, permissions, and client communications.
  • Maintain strong governance around administrative access, configuration changes, recording policies, integrations, credentials, and other high-risk platform components.
  • Partner with IT and Security to ensure the Genesys environment aligns with enterprise security, identity, data-handling, and access-management standards.
  • Surface material platform, compliance, capacity, vendor, or integration risks early and bring forward clear recommendations and next steps.

What You Bring

Required:

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in contact center technology, CCaaS, telecommunications, platform engineering, or a related field, including significant hands-on responsibility in production contact center environments.
  • 5+ years of hands-on Genesys Cloud CX administration, architecture, or engineering experience, with deep expertise in Architect flows, IVR logic, routing, queues, skills, priorities, overflow strategies, and multi-queue environments.
  • Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring, or building technical teams responsible for contact center platforms, administration, engineering, or support.
  • Strong experience with outbound dialing and campaign management, including contact lists, pacing modes, callbacks, callable-time controls, compliance settings, and performance optimization.
  • Strong working knowledge of contact center telephony, including SIP, carriers, DID management, call routing, recording, transfers, and troubleshooting complex voice issues.
  • Experience integrating Genesys Cloud with Salesforce or other CRM platforms using data actions, APIs, webhooks, screen pops, workflow automation, and related integration patterns.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions and explain complex platform issues, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred (Nice to Have):

  • Genesys Cloud CX certification at the Professional, Architect, or comparable advanced level.
  • Experience with BYOC, SIP carriers, telecommunications vendors, and enterprise voice troubleshooting.
  • Experience implementing AI-driven contact center capabilities such as Agent Assist, AI routing, speech and text analytics, transcription, automated summaries, or journey orchestration.

Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

  • Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"
  • Committed: You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.
  • No-Ego Energy: Positive, professional, and solutions-oriented. Drama stays at the door.
  • Ownership: You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.
  • Fast & Hungry: You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

What We Offer

  • Base Salary: $157,000 and $179,000, commensurate with experience
  • Eligible for performance-based bonus
  • Our job postings reflect the compensation range for the specific market and location of each role. Ranges vary by geography based on local market rates and cost of labor.
  • Benefits include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, HSA, life insurance, disability coverage, paid time off, and parental leave.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an equal opportunity employer. Employment selection and related decisions are made without regard to age, race, color, national origin, religion, sex, disability, sexual orientation, gender identification, or being a qualified disabled veteran or qualified veteran of the Vietnam era or any other category protected by Federal or State law.

raw.description:
At Tribe Wellness Sales, we're on a mission to help men live longer, stronger, more energized lives through supplements that actually deliver. But here's the catch: too many guys grab a product online and then flounder—unsure how to use it, stack it, or stick with it long enough to see results. That's where you, our Sales Specialist (called a Protocol Review Specialist in our world), make the difference. Without you, men miss out on better energy, strength, and confidence, and our mission stalls. With you? You're the spark that turns a purchase into a transformation—for him and everyone who benefits from him showing up as his best self.

What You'll Do:

  • Sell: You'll sell products and services for our men's health client, a company built for health-conscious men, by health-conscious men, with over a million happy customers and growing.

  • Grow: Work with a broad range of potential customers, transforming clients' prospects into brand loyalists.

  • Learn: Work closely with our dedicated leaders, leveraging our top-notch training resources to master the art of selling and representing Tribe's ethos.

  • Earn: Operate with no cap on commission, providing limitless earning potential.

  • Live:Work from home in a global remote environment to have more time for what really matters, because commutes aren't fun.

  • Sales Ethics:We are highly compliant and sell ethically, following all regulatory requirements of the FTC, never overpromising what a product can do or making unsubstantiated claims.

  • Brand Integrity: We partner with brands that care about what their selling, working with those who sell products of the highest quality and follow strict FDA regulations.

What We Offer:

Choose the pay structure that best fits your goals—both offer uncapped commission potential, with estimated first-year on-target earnings: $55,000–$100,000, with uncapped upside based on performance.

  • Hourly + Commission: Earn your applicable state minimum hourly pay, paid every pay period and never offset against commission, plus 4%–12% commission on net sales every two weeks.

  • Higher-Commission Plan: Earn 14%–17% commission on net sales (approximately 20%–25% of gross sales) every two weeks. If your commission falls below your applicable state minimum wage, you’ll receive a non-recoverable minimum earnings guarantee—you will never owe it back or have it deducted from future commissions.

  • Paid Sales Training: Your first week you'll be deep in training, learning everything about our sales scripts, process, compliance, and learning our systems such as, Rippling, Salesforce, and Vonage.

  • Remote Work:You’ll have the freedom of a fully remote position, allowing for a work-life balance that suits your lifestyle.

  • Be Part of the Tribe: No matter your title, you’ll join a community that values partnership, advocacy, and growth. We believe in nurturing our team members and fostering an environment of collaboration, support, and mutual success. Check our team success stories here!

What We're Looking For:

  • Highly-driven self-starters, motivated by growth opportunities and the drive to excel in sales.

  • Knowledge, background, or genuine passion around men's health, fitness, or performance nutrition.

  • Excellent verbal and written skills, with top-notch communication and a knack for building genuine connections.

  • Ability to work 40 hours per week (8 hours per day) starting at 8 AM CST.

  • Reliable internet and equipment, since this role involves frequent phone and video calls requiring clear, uninterrupted conversations.

This means you should have:

  • A fast, reliable laptop or desktop with a working mic, camera, and headset to comfortably run our call system, Salesforce, and Zoom simultaneously.

  • Ethernet connection strongly preferred for the most consistent call quality (usually just an inexpensive cable connecting your device to your modem).

  • Dedicated internet speed of at least 10 Mbps download / 5 Mbps upload, with latency under ~150ms, jitter under ~30ms, and packet loss under ~1%.

Join us if you're ready to play a pivotal role in reshaping the world of men's health and wellness while thriving in a growth-centric global environment with amazing people. If that sounds like you, Tribe Wellness is your tribe. Apply today and work with a very different type of company.

raw.description:
Headway Incis a global tech company, revolutionizing lifelong learning by creating digital products for over 170 million users worldwide. Our mission is to help people grow. We're proud to be ranked 4th among the World's Top EdTech Сompanies by TIME magazine. We believe lifelong learning should be accessible, personalized, and impactful to each individual. That's how we change the world and why we bring together exceptional minds.

Our globalization function makes sure every Headway product feels like it was built for the market it lands in. We're now looking for a Globalization Coordinator to ensure localization and globalization operations across Nibble, Skillsta, and other supported products run smoothly — so that deliverables are completed accurately, consistently, efficiently, and on time, while continuously improving how the work gets done.

The team you'll be working with

You'll be part of the Globalization team, working at the intersection of product, design, marketing, and linguistic expertise. Alongside you, there is another coordinator, a Growth Globalization Manager, and a network of linguistic experts who keep our products feeling local. Your work directly shapes how quickly and accurately content reaches users across languages and markets.

This role is your calling if you

  • Confidently and proactively use AI tools in your day-to-day work.

  • Have strong project and operations management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple workflows and stakeholders.

  • Take a high level of ownership and accountability for outcomes.

  • Can give, receive, and act on feedback, following radical candor principles.

  • Communicate clearly and respectfully, drawing on principles of nonviolent communication.

  • Have a strong see-do mindset: you notice what needs to be done and take initiative to move it forward.

  • Bring a collaborative, team-first approach.

  • Are comfortable working with ambiguity, evolving processes, and changing priorities.

  • Bring strong cultural curiosity and openness to different markets, perspectives, and ways of working.

What you'll do

  • Localization delivery: Coordinate the localization and production of Nibble and Skillsta lessons across supported languages, extending support to other products upon request.

  • Workflow & people: Coordinate workflows and dependencies with Globalization and product teams, and workload distribution among linguistic experts alongside other coordinators.

  • Quality & guidelines: Create, maintain, and improve localization and operations guidelines; coordinate quality checks of NMT/AI-assisted tools.

  • Operations & reporting: Oversee time tracking for linguistic experts, support administrative system workflows, and report issues promptly.

  • Continuous improvement: Identify operational gaps and help improve processes and tools; support automation implementation and maintenance.

  • Analytics: Perform on-demand analytics requests with the support of AI tools.

What do we offer

  • Work within an ambitious team on a socially impactful education product.

  • Hands-on training on our AI-assisted tools and localization workflows — genuine openness to learn matters more than prior hands-on experience.

  • Regular check-ins, feedback, and growth conversations with your manager.

Location

Remote, with the Europe time zone being our preference for this role.

Are you interested? Send your CV!

raw.excerpt: As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena is committed to a people-first approach.
raw.description:
As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena is committed to a people-first approach. Our teams enjoy a culture focused on prioritizing a flexible work environment that empowers individual growth, well-being, and belonging. We’re a technology company that leads with our humanity—driving our business priorities alongside meaningful social, community, and societal impact.

Data Scientist – Supply Chain Optimisation

As a Data Scientist within Ciena’s Supply Chain Optimisation team, this role applies advanced analytics to complex, global supply chain challenges that directly impact cost, service performance, and sustainability outcomes. The position contributes to data‑driven decision making across procurement, planning, engineering, operations, and logistics functions. This role supports scalable optimization solutions aligned with Ciena’s operational priorities.

How you will make an impact:

  • Design and implement optimization models addressing network design, inventory positioning, demand forecasting, and transportation efficiency.
  • Apply advanced analytics techniques to improve supply chain performance, cost efficiency, service levels, and sustainability outcomes.
  • Analyze, cleanse, and transform large, imperfect datasets to generate actionable insights.
  • Develop algorithms using optimization, machine learning, and statistical modeling techniques to solve complex supply chain problems.
  • Implement production‑ready analytical solutions using Python, R, or comparable programming languages.
  • Build dashboards and analytical outputs that communicate insights to technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and architects to ensure scalable and aligned analytical solutions.

The must haves:

  • Education: Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or optimization roles, including exposure to supply chain problem domains.
  • Application of programming languages such as Python or R for analytical and modeling solutions.
  • Application of machine learning and statistical modeling techniques within supply chain contexts.
  • Utilization of optimization libraries such as OR‑Tools, Pyomo, or Gurobi.
  • Application of SQL or similar tools for data manipulation and analysis.
  • Translation of business problems into analytical approaches that deliver actionable outcomes.

Nice to haves:

  • Background working with modern data platforms such as Snowflake and transformation tools such as dbt.
  • Exposure to geospatial analytics or network visualization tools.
  • Experience supporting global supply chain environments or complex organizational structures.
  • Background using Dataiku or Alteryx One.

At Ciena, we are committed to building and fostering an environment in which our employees feel respected, valued, and heard. Ciena values the diversity of its workforce and respects its employees as individuals. We do not tolerate any form of discrimination.

The Senior Director of Enterprise Security Architecture (ESA) leads the definition, governance, and enforcement of enterprise-wide security architecture strategy for the enterprise. The position partners closely with the CISO, other Information Security Sr. Leaders, and other Technology Leadership teams to establish a vision and strategy required to ensure scalable, measurable, and continuously improving defense capabilities across all security domains in collaboration with other information security domain leaders and partner organizations.

raw.description:
Axia Women's Health is the nation’s largest community-based, integrated women's health network in the country serving women throughout New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Indiana, and Kentucky. At its core, Axia Women’s Health is a community of over 400 providers across nearly 150 locations committed to providing a more caring, connected, and progressive health care experience for women. Its rapidly growing network spans OB/GYN care, breast health, high-risk pregnancy care, urogynecology care, behavioral health, and fertility. Together, Axia Women's Health puts women first by delivering the personalized care needed for women to lead healthier, happier lives. Axia Women’s Health has been recognized as the #1 Physician Practice for Women’s Healthby Castle Connolly and certified as a Great Place to Work for five consecutive years. Learn more at www.axiawh.com.

The Center for Healthy Living, an Axia Women's Health care center, is hiring a full-time Nurse Practitioner - Menopause Care and Wellness.

This specialized Nurse Practitioner provides specialized, evidence-based virtual care for patients with menopause-related concerns, including sexual health, bone health, sleep, and other aspects of midlife women’s health. The role serves both self-referred patients and those referred by Axia OB/GYN providers, providing focused evaluation, treatment, education, and follow-up. This position complements care provided in Axia’s in-person practices by serving as a specialty resource for patients requiring additional expertise or focused management, while maintaining communication with the referring provider and supporting continuity of care with the patient’s established OB/GYN as the primary coordinator of their overall gynecologic and menopause care.

Specialty Menopause Care

  • Provide comprehensive virtual evaluation, diagnosis, treatment, education, and follow-up for patients experiencing menopause-related symptoms and concerns.
  • Serve as a clinical resource for menopause-related conditions and symptom domains, including sexual health and wellness, osteoporosis and bone health, sleep, and other long-term consequences or sequelae of menopause.
  • Develop individualized treatment plans that may include hormone therapy, non-hormonal therapies, lifestyle interventions, patient education, and appropriate referrals.
  • Provide care for both self-referred patients and patients referred by Axia OB/GYN providers.
  • Communicate relevant clinical findings, recommendations, and treatment plans to referring OB/GYN, when applicable, following patient visits.
  • Support continuity and coordination of care with the patient’s established OB/GYN provider and other members of the care team.
  • Maintain current knowledge of evidence-based menopause care and specialty-specific guidelines, including recommendations from the Menopause Society and other relevant professional organizations.

General Menopause Care

  • Provide comprehensive menopause symptom management for patients referred by Axia OB/GYN providers who may benefit from additional virtual menopause expertise or support.
  • Evaluate and manage common menopause-related concerns, including vasomotor symptoms, mood changes, weight and metabolic concerns, cognitive symptoms, and other manifestations of menopause, within the APP’s scope of practice.
  • Collaborate with referring OB/GYN provider when patients present with complex symptoms or require care beyond the scope of the virtual menopause program.
  • Identify and appropriately refer non-menopause-related medical concerns to patient’s OB/GYN, primary care provider, or other appropriate specialist rather than managing conditions outside the scope of the program.
  • Participate in quality review of virtual care outcomes, clinical metrics, and patient experience data.

Program Development & Network Support

  • Serve as an active member of the Menopause Clinician Workgroup, providing clinical expertise, feedback, and thought leadership.
  • Contribute to the development and refinement of clinical protocols, workflows, patient education, and provider resources.
  • Develop educational materials and resources related to complex menopause symptom management that can be shared across the Axia network.
  • Support provider education and awareness of available virtual menopause and sexual wellness services.
  • Collaborate with the Menopause Medical Director and broader clinical team to identify opportunities for clinical quality improvement and program development.

Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated clinical expertise in menopause management, including hormone replacement therapy (HRT), non-hormonal treatment options, and management of complex patients.
  • Specialized knowledge and experience in menopause-related concerns, particularly sexual health and wellness, bone health/osteoporosis, sleep, and other midlife women’s health issues.
  • Strong clinical judgement and ability to independently evaluate and manage patients through virtual care.
  • Comfortable delivering care across telehealth modalities and effectively engaging patients in a virtual environment.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, particularly when coordinating care with referring OB/GYNs and other clinicians.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain additional state licensure as required to support Axia’s virtual care model.
  • Commitment to evidence-based, patients-centered care and continuous clinical learning.

Required Education & Experience:

  • Graduate of an accredited Master of Science in Nursing (MSN), Master of Science (MS), or Doctor of Nursing Practice (DNP) program.
  • Board certification as a WHNP, FNP, ANP, or AGNP.
  • Current, unrestricted advanced practice licensure in at least one of the following states: NJ, PA, KY, or IN.
  • Menopause Society Certified Practitioner (MSCP) credential or actively pursuing credential.
  • Demonstrated clinical experience in menopause management, including prescribing and managing hormone therapy.
  • Experience developing clinical education, provider resources, or program materials.
  • Experience participating in clinical program development, workgroups, or quality improvement initiatives preferred.
  • Experience with eClinicalWorks (eCW) a plus.

Benefits:

  • Group-paid Malpractice Insurance coverage.
  • Group-reimbursed licensure and renewals.
  • Full-time benefit-eligibility with benefits beginning the first of the month after starting and choice of multiple medical insurance plans.
  • No-cost healthcare perks included with your Axia Medical Plan, including Revive (Telemedicine), Quantum Health (Healthcare Concierge), and Hinge Health (Virtual Physical Therapy)

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

raw.description:
At LegitScript, we are passionate about making the internet and payment ecosystems safer and more transparent. We help companies of all sizes keep their services legal and safe for consumers. To do this, LegitScript combines big data with the world’s leading team of experts skilled in highly regulated and complex sectors, including transaction laundering detection, pharmaceuticals, online gambling, and more.

The result? Unmatched accuracy and deep risk analysis that identifies which commercial entities play by the rules, and which do not. Our diverse industry partnerships provide unique insights that keep businesses and governments at the forefront of emerging trends. That’s why LegitScript is trusted by the world's largest search engines, internet platforms, payment companies, and regulatory agencies.

Overview:

You'll own the full lifecycle — from raw data ingestion to model deployment to measuring real-world business impact — with a current focus on building a sophisticated risk detection system using LLMs, Generative AI techniques, and classical ML within our SaaS platform. This is not a pure engineering role or a pure research role. You'll need both, and you'll need to move fluidly between them.

What You'll Do:

Data Science & Applied ML

  • Research, prototype, and develop ML and LLM-based models to solve complex business problems, with a current focus on risk detection and prioritization
  • Wrap models into production-ready APIs and integrate them into our core product
  • Ensure model outputs are interpretable — translating predictions into actionable reason codes for end users
  • Partner directly with operational teams to gather feedback, refine features, and improve model relevance over time

Data Engineering

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable pipelines to ingest data from disparate sources into our data warehouse/lake
  • Implement robust data validation, quality checks, and transformation workflows across raw, curated, and serving layers
  • Build and maintain curated datasets optimized for both analytics and model training use cases

MLOps & Production Ownership

  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for both data workflows and ML model deployment across environments
  • Monitor pipeline latency, data drift, and model performance in production; design alerting and retraining triggers
  • Own the business outcomes of your models — define success metrics, track ROI, and iterate based on real-world efficacy
  • Manage infrastructure as code and containerized deployments to ensure reproducible, environment-consistent releases

What You'll Bring:

  • 5–8+ years spanning data engineering and data science/ML, with a demonstrated track record of shipping models to production
  • Strong Python proficiency; experience with Spark/PySpark for large-scale data processing
  • Advanced SQL for complex transformation, analysis, and data modeling
  • Hands-on experience with cloud data platforms such as Databricks or Snowflake
  • Experience with ETL/ELT frameworks — dbt, Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, Databricks Autoloader, Informatica, or similar
  • Familiarity with ML experiment tracking tools such as MLflow or Weights & Biases
  • DevOps fluency: Git-based development, branching strategies, CI/CD, IaC (DABs/Terraform), and Docker
  • Experience with orchestration tools such as Databricks Workflows or Apache Airflow

Strong Plus

  • Hands-on experience with LLMs and Generative AI techniques in a production context (prompt engineering, RAG architectures, fine-tuning, or evaluation frameworks)
  • Experience building or operating ML platforms, feature stores, or model registries
  • Prior work in risk, compliance, fraud detection, or other high-stakes ML domains

We succeed together, care deeply, stay curious, and inspire trust — and we look for those qualities in the people we hire. LegitScript offers competitive compensation, flexible work options, and a team that's genuinely invested in your success. If our mission resonates with you, we'd love to hear from you.

Born from the merger of the Stellantis Group 🚗 and the start-up TravelCar, Free2move, thanks to its agility and its spirit of conquest has managed to establish itself in just few years as a reference player to revolutionize the mobility of all travellers.

Having become the #1 reflex for more than 6 million users, Free2move operates in more than 170 countries across different continents 🌎 and is available in 30 languages and 26 currencies. 5000 partners trust us and several hundred thousand vehicles are available!

If you want to join a team of +650 experts and bold international projects, then you're in the right place! 🎯

You will evolve in an ultra-dynamic, innovative, agile, internationally-focused structure and integrate our talented teams, full of ideas and motivation and with multidisciplinary skills, at the crossroads of the digital eco-system and the fast-changing automotive sector.

At Free2Move, data science and analytics are at the very core of our products and decision-making. Our analytics team tackles a wide range of impactful topics—from influencing key business decisions and optimizing operations, to putting the algorithms that govern critical aspects of our products into production.

You will be joining our dedicated Pricing Analytics team, which takes charge of all topics related to pricing.

We deeply understand pricing dynamics and use this expertise to build and improve Machine Learning algorithms that define our pricing in real-time.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Collaborating closely with Data Scientists to bring state-of-the-art, real-time pricing algorithms to production for millions of users.

  • Taking full ownership of the data pipelines within the Pricing Analytics scope.

  • Architecting and building the right systems to solve highly complex or vaguely defined problems.

  • Engaging with cross-functional stakeholders to lead the design, development, optimization, and productionization of ML and ML-based solutions.

  • Managing the infrastructure on which our Pricing algorithm runs and taking responsibility for the performance of the pricing ML system.

  • Leading cross-team efforts to leverage and scale our ML infrastructure for model development, training, and deployment needs.

  • Writing well-crafted, well-tested, readable, and maintainable production-quality code.

Who You Are & What You Bring We believe in team success over individual achievement and foster a highly collaborative environment. To thrive in this role, you bring:

  • Education: A degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

  • Coding Expertise: Expert-level proficiency in SQL and Python, with a strong track record of writing clean, modular, optimized code for complex data transformations. (Note: Previous experience as a Data Scientist is a strong plus!)

  • Data Modeling: Significant hands-on experience modeling enterprise Data Warehouses using dbt (including Kimball methodology, dimensional modeling, star schemas, data testing, and data lineage).

  • Cloud & Big Data: Strong experience with the Databricks ecosystem (Delta Lake, PySpark, Unity Catalog, SQL Endpoints, Serverless compute) and AWS cloud infrastructure (S3, IAM, KMS, DataSync).

  • Orchestration & DevOps: Solid experience writing and orchestrating complex production DAGs using Apache Airflow (or MWAA), managing deployments with Docker/Kubernetes, and working with CI/CD pipelines (Git, GitHub Actions, Terraform).

  • Data Visualization: Hands-on experience building, optimizing, and maintaining enterprise dashboards using Tableau, PowerBI, or Databricks SQL Dashboards.

  • Modern Workflows: A habit of actively leveraging AI tools (like Claude and Databricks AI features) to accelerate pipeline creation, automate dbt documentation, and write smart PR review guardrails.

  • Compliance & Security: A solid understanding of GDPR requirements, including how to enforce PII masking, access control policies, data retention, and auditing via Unity Catalog.

  • Mindset & Communication: An analytical mindset capable of translating complex business requirements into scalable, bulletproof data marts and KPI metrics. You prefer simple, efficient, well-tested code over fragile architectures. You can also communicate complex technical concepts clearly to business stakeholders and domain teams (Pricing, Customer, Advanced Analytics).

  • Languages: Fluency in English (written and oral) is required to work effectively in our international context.

Working at Free2move means becoming part of a tribe in which the culture of performance rhymes with a good atmosphere. It is also:

  • A start-up spirit supported by a large Group

Responsibilities include configuring, testing, documenting, troubleshooting, and optimizing application solutions to ensure reliable system performance, operational efficiency, and alignment with business objectives.

The successful candidate will help analyze business and system support needs, document user-reported issues, assist with configuration and enhancement requests, support testing and validation activities, maintain runbooks and knowledge articles, and contribute to reliable, compliant application operations. This role requires strong communication, attention to detail, analytical thinking, documentation discipline, customer focus, and the ability to work effectively in a regulated environment with defined change control and testing expectations.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Duties include but are not limited to:

  • Assist in designing, documenting, testing, and supporting integrations between FSM, Infor OS, and other enabling business applications.

  • Partners with reporting and analytics teams to support Power BI data questions, reconciliation needs, KPI definition clarity, and operational dashboard follow-up.

  • Creates and maintains support documentation, runbooks, issue summaries, meeting notes, test evidence, release notes, knowledge articles, and standard operating support procedures.

  • Assists with monitoring application(s) health, integration performance, recurring failures, release impacts, data quality trends, and operational readiness items; gathers examples and supporting detail for escalation.

  • Provides timely and clear communication to stakeholders regarding issue status, ticket updates, testing progress, risks, blockers, and supports next steps.

  • Contributes to continuous improvement of support processes, documentation standards, testing checklists, monitoring practices, and knowledge sharing across the application support team.

  • Works in an environment with changing business priorities while following established support processes, maintaining customer focus, and escalating risks or blockers appropriately.

  • Experience supporting ERP, finance, healthcare, life sciences, or regulated environments

  • Ability to work through ambiguity, ask effective discovery questions, identify patterns, document assumptions, and escalate risks appropriately.

Physical & Mental Demands and Working Conditions

raw.description:
7-Eleven is an iconic family of brands with over 86,000 locations, surpassing every retailer in the world. We revolutionize convenience, restaurants and fuel through cutting edge innovation — working hard to be the customer's first choice. 7-Eleven empowers our employees to "activate awesome" and make a meaningful impact in their stores and communities every day. If you're ready to grow, lead and make a difference, come join our team and help shape the future of convenience.

This position is open to candidates across Canada. For candidates based in Surrey, the role follows a hybrid work model. For the right candidate, a fully remote arrangement may also be considered.

The Manager, Web & Digital Experience is customer-obsessed and data-driven, and responsible for the end-to-end management, performance, and optimization of 7-Eleven Canada’s digital ecosystem. This role ensures all website and app experiences – including 7-Eleven.ca, SpeakOut, 7Rewards, 7Now, and future digital products – deliver best-in-class usability, performance, and brand consistency.

Reporting to the Sr. Manager, Digital & E-Commerce, this role leads the Canadian web and digital platform experience, partners closely with U.S. product and development teams, and provides strategic oversight and technical leadership of UX/UI quality across all customer-facing digital touchpoints. This role also provides operational oversight of digital platform functionality, content management systems, digital integrations, and web performance optimization across owned digital properties. This role also directly manages and coaches the Specialist, Web & Digital Experience to deliver seamless and conversion-driving digital experiences.

Responsibilities

Website, App, and Digital Platform Ownership

  • Manage and own the full lifecycle, performance, optimization, and content for 7-Eleven.ca and the SpeakOut websites, ensuring alignment with business priorities and content strategy.

  • Define the Canadian web and digital platform strategy aligned with business objectives and content strategy, including SEO, user experience, conversion optimization.

  • Ensure platforms deliver exceptional UX/UI, fast performance, accessibility compliance, and strong alignment with brand and business goals.

  • Oversee integrations between Canadian web properties, the 7Rewards app, 7Now delivery experiences, and future digital channels (e.g.,7Merch, e-commerce initiatives).

  • Oversee platform operations including CMS governance, release coordination, digital workflows, and support for ongoing platform stability and performance.

UX/UI Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Provide UX/UI leadership across all owned digital platforms, validating design feasibility within CMS and platform templates.

  • Guide the Specialist, Copywriter, Graphic Designer, and marketing stakeholders to ensure cohesive, on-brand digital experiences.

  • Collaborate with U.S. development teams and external design partners to align on technical capabilities, design direction, and roadmap priorities.

  • Provide guidance on technical feasibility, CMS limitations, responsive behaviour, and implementation requirements during digital project planning and execution.

Performance, Analytics & Optimization

  • Own and manage digital performance KPIs for all Canadian web properties, including engagement, conversion, task completion, site speed, SEO/SEM performance, and user behaviour.

  • Lead ongoing performance analysis dashboards, and monthly reporting, translating insights into optimization recommendations.

  • Monitor and provide recommendations for improvements related to site speed, technical SEO health, mobile performance, accessibility compliance, and customer experience optimization.

SEO/SEM Strategy & Execution

  • Lead SEO strategy through regular audits, content optimization, and technical improvements to grow rankings for key commercial and high-intent terms (e.g., “coffee near me,” “pizza near me”).

  • Partner with agency and internal teams to execute SEM strategy, including performance monitoring, landing page optimization, and alignment with search demand trends.

  • Embed SEO/SEM best practices into content development, campaign briefs, and digital initiatives.

  • Ensure that online store listings are kept up-to-date and optimized.

  • Partner with internal and external teams to support technical SEO implementation, metadata governance, URL structure management, and search optimization best practices.

Roadmap & Stakeholder Management

  • Develop and maintain a Canadian digital platform product roadmap aligned with business priorities, marketing strategy, and U.S. development timelines.

  • Represent Canadian business needs in monthly U.S./Canada digital meetings, advocating for enhancements that improve customer experience and operational efficiency.

  • Collaborate with technical, agency, and platform partners to prioritize enhancements, resolve operational issues, and support platform evolution.

Team Leadership

  • Directly manage and coach the Specialist, providing clear priorities, feedback, and development support.

  • Champion a culture of data-driven decision-making, customer-centric design and continuous optimization within the marketing team.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Digital Media, or a related field; advanced training or certifications in product management, UX/UI, SEO/SEM, or analytics are strong assets.

  • 5+ years of experience in digital product management, platform ownership, or web/app optimization — ideally in retail, convenience, QSR, or consumer brands.

  • A passion for starting with the customer and building a customer- and data-obsessed digital team.

  • Strong technical capabilities with the ability to lead digital platform optimization, web operations, and customer-facing digital experiences within CMS-driven environments.

  • Strong understanding of CMS platforms, UX/UI design principles, and mobile app ecosystems.

  • Knowledge of website architecture, digital integrations, responsive web behavior, technical SEO, and digital release processes.

  • Experience collaborating with developers, agencies, or technical platform teams to deliver digital enhancements and troubleshoot platform issues.

  • Demonstrated experience in SEO/SEM strategy, web analytics, and digital performance measurement.

  • Proficiency with digital analytics tools and reporting platforms.

  • Strong project management capabilities with a proven ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and cross‑functional collaboration skills.

  • Experience leading teams and managing direct reports.

raw.description:
This position has a full salary range of $68,500 - $108,000 per year with eligibility for commission. Starting salary is based on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, geographic location and experience. The target hiring range for this role is $68,500 - $85,000.

Candidates for this role must live in a major metropolitan area.

Role Overview:

The Business Development Executive will drive new revenue for Dirty Hands by selling our merchandising services to natural CPG brands. This is a hunting role. You will build your own pipeline, run discovery conversations that uncover what a brand actually needs, and move those opportunities from proposal to close.

Above all, this is an outbound role. That means creating a steady flow of your own opportunities through cold outreach, networking, store-checks, and events. The brands you close will be the ones you went out and found.

The services you sell help natural CPG brands win on the shelf. Dirty Hands is a known and respected name in the space, backed by real relationships at the store level, so you are reaching out with credibility behind you rather than starting cold every time. Success is measured on one thing, revenue closed. A healthy pipeline is how you get there, but what counts is what gets signed. This role is a strong fit if you have a track record of creating your own opportunities and carrying them through to the close.

This is a remote role. Regular team and company meetings keep everyone aligned, but you will need to be self-motivated about staying connected the rest of the time. It suits someone who has sold this way before and knows how to stay productive without an office around them.

What You’ll Own:

Prospecting & Pipeline Generation

  • Build and sustain a self-sourced pipeline through cold outreach, email, networking, store-checks, and industry events, without waiting for leads to be handed over.
  • Conduct market research to find emerging brands and untapped opportunities that fit Dirty Hands.
  • Represent Dirty Hands at trade shows and networking events, building relationships that convert into qualified opportunities.
  • Use store-level data and shelf photos captured by our field teams, along with SPINS data, to surface opportunities and show prospective brands what is happening with their products at retail.

Discovery & Selling

  • Lead discovery conversations that uncover a brand's goals, gaps, and buying criteria before proposing a solution.
  • Translate what you learn in discovery into tailored pitches and case studies that show the value of Dirty Hands' merchandising services.
  • Deliver sales presentations, pulling in data, case studies, and internal experts when they strengthen the pitch.

Follow-up, Proposals & Closing

  • Own the full deal cycle from first meeting through proposal, negotiation, and signed contract.
  • Develop and present proposals that clearly connect Dirty Hands' services to the outcomes a brand is trying to reach.
  • Drive consistent follow-up so opportunities keep moving and do not stall between stages.
  • Negotiate and close agreements that work for both the brand and Dirty Hands.

Expansion & Internal Partnership

  • Grow existing accounts by spotting new opportunities and turning strong relationships into new revenue.
  • Coordinate with strategy and merchandising leadership, pulling them in to shape offers and keeping them informed as deals develop.
  • Contribute to lead generation campaigns and pass what you are seeing in the market back to the team.

Pipeline Management & Reporting

  • Keep opportunities accurate and current in our CRM so the pipeline and forecast reflect reality.
  • Report on sales activity and progress against targets on a regular cadence.
  • Stay current on industry trends, retailer programs, competitor offerings, and Dirty Hands' internal programs to refine how you sell.

What We’re Looking For:

Three areas matter most for this role: prospecting and creating your own opportunities, running discovery and selling, and moving deals through follow-up, proposals, and close. Strength across all three is what we look for first, so be ready to show real, specific experience in each.

Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in a business development or sales role. Experience within the natural CPG industry at a brand, broker, or merchandiser is a plus.
  • A track record of prospecting and creating your own opportunities, not just working inbound or assigned leads.
  • Demonstrated success in discovery and selling, turning what you learn about a brand into a pitch that lands.
  • A proven record of carrying deals through follow-up, proposals, and to a signed close, consistently against a target.
  • Experience selling services or solutions, not only products, into CPG brands is strongly preferred.
  • Prior experience selling in a remote, self-directed role is strongly preferred. This is not a first remote job; you should already know how to run your own pipeline and stay disciplined without in-person structure.
  • An existing network of brand or retailer relationships in natural CPG is a strong plus.

Core Strengths

  • Self-motivated and resilient, able to keep building your own pipeline through the grind and the rejection that outbound selling involves.
  • A genuine listener who uncovers what a brand actually needs before pitching a solution.
  • Persistent through follow-up and negotiation, keeping deals moving without letting relationships go cold.
  • Clear and persuasive with the people who own the decision, from a founder or CEO to a VP of sales, and able to make the financial case when a CFO is in the room.
  • Disciplined about where you spend your time, and organized enough to run several opportunities at once without dropping any.

Technical Skills

  • Comfortable working in a CRM to manage your pipeline, track activity, and report on progress. We use HubSpot; experience with it is a plus.
  • Able to work with syndicated and store-level data, including SPINS, and turn it into a clear, persuasive case for a brand.
  • Confident building polished pitches and proposals that hold up in front of brand decision-makers.
  • Proficient in Google Workspace or Microsoft Office.

Travel & Physical Requirements

  • Willingness to travel up to 12 weeks per year to attend trade shows, client meetings, time in the field with our merchandising teams, and other in-person events.
  • Able to work in a seated position for extended periods of time.

Benefits:

  • Competitive pay with eligibility for yearly merit-based wage increases.
  • Eligibility for quarterly bonus based on performance (up to 10%).
  • Comprehensive benefits package including partially company-paid medical insurance, and fully company-paid dental, vision, life and disability insurance.
  • FREE First Stop Health: virtual care and mental health coverage.
  • Three weeks of paid time off per year. In addition to paid time off, 9 paid holidays and one additional floating holiday.
  • Mileage reimbursement plan.
  • 401k plan.
  • Use of company-owned devices to complete assigned tasks.
  • An exceptional company culture with opportunities for engagement and growth.

About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

About the role

The Commercial Auto Excess Casualty Adjuster (with the attorney background) plays a critical role in managing high-severity commercial auto liability claims that may exceed primary policy limits. At Reserv, this specialist leverages cutting-edge automation, structured data, and modern claims systems to drive optimal outcomes while focusing on the most complex, high-impact aspects of claim handling. The role requires deep technical expertise, strong analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate within a fast-moving, technology-driven environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • You will investigate, evaluate, and resolve complex commercial auto liability claims involving excess layers of coverage, catastrophic injuries, multi-vehicle accidents, and high-exposure scenarios.
  • This role will conduct advanced coverage analysis, including policy interpretation, endorsements, exclusions, and multi-jurisdictional considerations.
  • Issue coverage position letters, including reservations of rights and denials, in alignment with regulatory and internal standards.
  • Oversee litigation, partnering with defense counsel to evaluate strategy, monitor case progression, and ensure cost-effective, data-driven decision-making.
  • This adjuster will leverage Reserv's AI-powered tools to review claim summaries, severity predictions, and structured data insights to enhance accuracy and efficiency.
  • Evaluate primary carrier handling and determine when excess involvement is triggered, ensuring timely and appropriate intervention.
  • Collaborate with MGAs, carriers, brokers, and internal teams, providing clear communication and maintaining Reserv's high-touch, white-glove service standards.
  • Document all claim activity within Reserv's modern claims platform, ensuring data accuracy and compliance with internal and external requirements.
  • You will participate in audits, trend analysis, and feedback loops to support continuous improvement and inform underwriting insights.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • 10+ years of commercial auto liability or casualty claims experience, preferably with excess or high-severity files.
  • J.D. from an accredited law school and an active license in good standing in at least one U.S. state is needed
  • Strong knowledge of coverage analysis, litigation management, and complex liability evaluation.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex issues into clear, actionable insights.
  • Comfort working in a technology-driven environment with modern systems and data-rich workflows.
  • Active insurance adjuster's license by way of a designated home state; home state license required if home state license is available
  • Willing to obtain all licenses within 60 days, including completing state required testing

PREFERRED SKILLS & CERTIFICATIONS

  • AIC, CPCU, SCLA, or similar designations.
  • Experience with MGAs, TPAs, or non-admitted/excess & surplus lines.
  • Familiarity with AI-enhanced claims tools or modern claims platforms (a strong plus at Reserv).

Benefits

  • Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
  • Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
  • Work from anywhere to facilitate your work life balance
  • Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

Additionally, we will

  • Listen to your feedback to enhance and improve upon the long-standing challenges of an adjuster and the claims role
  • Work toward reducing and eliminating all the administrative work from an adjuster role
  • Foster a culture of empathy, transparency, and empowerment in a remote-first environment

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

This is a great opportunity for an early-career Workday consultant who is interested in expanding their experience into Eightfold and the rapidly evolving AI and talent technology space. The Consultant will work alongside experienced functional and technical team members, participate in client-facing delivery, and build expertise across both platforms.

Success in this role requires curiosity, strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, a willingness to learn new technologies, and the ability to collaborate effectively in a fast-paced consulting environment.

raw.description:
Role Summary

MarketMan builds restaurant management software for SMB and mid-market restaurant operators. Our sales team sells it directly to the people who run those businesses, and we win by understanding the operational and financial pain behind each one.

We're hiring a full-cycle Account Executive whose primary motion is outbound. You'll own every revenue opportunity across inbound, outbound, and partner channels, but the job is built on pipeline you create yourself: you self-source the majority of it. Inbound is a supplement, not the job.

The bar is a minimum of 100 outbound activities per day across calls, emails, social touches, and sequences. We publish that number because it's the prospecting discipline that fills your pipeline and feeds your quota, and we inspect outbound production every week. You carry two measured expectations: a new-business quota and a self-sourced pipeline target.

Please note: you must reside in one of the following states to qualify for this role - AZ, CT, FL, GA, ID, IN, KS, MI, MO, NC, NH, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA

Read This Before You Apply

This is a high-volume outbound seat. If you need warm inbound leads handed to you, or a defined book of business to work, you'll be miserable here, and it's better for both of us that you know that before applying. If you've built pipeline from cold, hit quota doing it, and can show the numbers, keep reading.

What You Will Own

  • The majority of your own pipeline, generated through 100+ daily outbound activities across calls, email, and LinkedIn.
  • A new-business quota with a 100% attainment expectation. You'll close restaurant operators in the 1–3 location range and progress at least 3 opportunities per day.
  • The full sales cycle: value-based discovery that surfaces operational and financial pain, tailored demos (an average of 2 per day, inbound plus outbound combined), objection handling, and negotiation through to signature.
  • A clean Salesforce pipeline. Next steps and close dates updated in real time, every deal on a scheduled next step within 72 hours, forecast accuracy within 10%.
  • Pipeline coverage of 3.0–3.5x entering each month, and a clear view of where the gaps are.
  • Working relationships with Marketing, Partner Managers, and the SDR/BDR team that move deals forward, while your number never depends on them.

What You Will Bring

Must-haves:

  • Proven outbound production, with numbers: activity volume, self-sourced pipeline created, and quota attainment you can walk us through.
  • Full-cycle closing skills, from first discovery call through negotiation and signature.
  • Salesforce (or similar CRM) fluency and the hygiene habits to keep it accurate in real time.
  • A track record in an outbound-heavy sales model.
  • High accountability. You own your metrics, your recaps, and your results without being chased.

Nice-to-haves:

  • SaaS sales experience in SMB or hospitality tech.
  • Familiarity with restaurant technology such as POS, accounting, or restaurant management software.
  • Time in a hybrid outbound/inbound or BDR-to-AE model.

How We Operate

You'll sell out of Salesforce, follow MarketMan's standardized sales process, and uphold our discounting rules. Each day ends with a short recap covering wins, losses, pipeline movement, and next steps, and you'll bring pipeline insights to team syncs. Success looks like consistent monthly quota attainment, pipeline created from both channels, and win rates that improve because your discovery does.

Compensation

Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission tied to quota.

How we feel about Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging-

MarketMan is committed to bringing together humans from different backgrounds and perspectives, providing employees with a safe and welcoming work environment free of discrimination and harassment.

We strive to create a diverse & inclusive environment where everyone can thrive, feel a sense of belonging, and do impactful work together.

As an equal opportunity employer, we prohibit any unlawful discrimination against a job applicant on the basis of their race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, family or parental status, disability*, age, veteran status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. We respect the laws enforced by the EEOC and are dedicated to going above and beyond in fostering diversity across our workplace.

*Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the terms of the Americans with Disabilities Act and certain state or local laws. A reasonable accommodation is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on Meal Ticket. Please inform our HR Team () if you need any assistance completing any forms or to otherwise participate in our application or interview process.

Salary: $60k ($120K OTE)

For over 30 years it has been CTI’s mission to help self-funded health plan sponsors reduce claim expense and improve service to their employees through independent audit and control of their third-party claim administration. Our philosophy of continuous quality improvement (CQI) techniques in conjunction with our statistical process control methodology allows us to ensure a high degree of consistency in our approach to medical claim auditing. Efficient planning and maximized use of our proprietary systems and technology produces a streamlined audit product requiring fewer hours than competitors to complete.

This internship offers an excellent opportunity for students or early-career professionals interested in healthcare claims, insurance, data analysis, and auditing. The position is remote and approximately 20 hours per week, with flexible scheduling.

Position Summary:

The Specific Stop Loss Claim Auditor Intern will support the Audit Team by reviewing medical claim documentation, analyzing data, and assisting with stop loss claim audits. The intern will gain hands-on experience with healthcare claims administration, reimbursement methodologies, and audit processes while working alongside experienced professionals in the industry.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist with reviewing and auditing specific stop loss claim submissions.

  • Validate claim documentation and supporting records for completeness and accuracy.

  • Analyze medical and pharmaceutical claims data.

  • Assist in identifying claim discrepancies, overpayments, and audit findings.

  • Utilize Excel and other Microsoft Office applications to organize, analyze, and report data.

  • Support auditors in preparing client reports and audit summaries.

  • Participate in process improvement initiatives and special projects.

  • Maintain confidentiality of protected health information (PHI) and sensitive client data.

  • Communicate effectively with team members regarding audit findings and project status.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Currently a sophomore in college pursuing a degree in Healthcare or a Science related field.

  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.

  • High attention to detail and strong organizational skills.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks in a remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Coursework or internship experience related to healthcare, insurance, auditing, or claims administration.

  • Familiarity with healthcare claims processing or medical billing concepts.

  • Experience using Excel features such as formulas, sorting, filtering, and pivot tables.

  • Exposure to healthcare reimbursement methodologies, including Medicare, DRG, or RBRVS.

  • Experience with Microsoft Access or other database applications.

Pay Range

$19.00 - $19.00 Hourly

The pay range provided above is made in good faith and based on our lowest and highest annual salary or hourly rate paid for the role and takes into account years of experience required, geography, and/or budget for the role.

  • Mental Health & Wellness: Free Mental Health & Enhanced Advocacy Services
  • Beyond Benefits: Paid Time Off, Holidays, Preferred Partner Discounts and more.

Not reflective of all benefits. Enrollment waiting periods or eligibility criteria may apply to certain benefits. Benefit details and offerings may vary for subsidiary entities or in specific geographic locations.

Additional information regarding this policy can be found on our careers page.

Apoiar o time de QA nas atividades de garantia da qualidade de sistemas, sites e aplicações.

raw.description:
Enterprise is a national nonprofit that exists to make a good home possible for the millions of families without one. We support community development organizations on the ground, aggregate and invest capital for impact, advance housing policy at every level of government, and build and manage communities ourselves. Since 1982, we have invested $92.0 billion and created 1.1 million homes across all 50 states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands – all to make home and community places of pride, power and belonging.

Join us at enterprisecommunity.org

Working at Enterprise

At Enterprise, you’ll be part of a diverse, committed team making a difference every day. You will collaborate with some of the smartest minds and biggest hearts in our field. You’ll be empowered to drive systems change and take bold steps to advance racial equity. And you will find a career home where you’re valued and supported in your growth journey.

Enterprise offers career opportunities in our offices across the country with an exceptional benefits package.

Job Description Summary

Enterprise Housing Credit Investments is seeking an experienced individual with Low-Income Housing Tax Credit (LIHTC) structuring and underwriting experience to serve as a Senior Manager in our LIHTC Structuring Services group. In this role, you will play a central part in ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of how Enterprise structures its Low-Income Housing Tax Credit (LIHTC) investments.

We are looking for someone with deep LIHTC expertise, exceptional analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate across multiple departments and external partners. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy solving complex financial and structuring challenges, we’d love to meet you.

Job Description

Responsibilities:

  • Review and refine financial models to ensure alignment with Enterprise modeling standards, including investor capital account and minimum gain analysis, evaluating entity structures, and confirming development cost classification.
  • Support underwriters and analysts by developing specialized model schedules, including those related to effective interest, OID, and other tax structuring conventions.
  • Partner with FIRM and Investor Relations to provide accurate, investor-ready financial information and return analyses.
  • Ensure consistency between project-level financial data and investor-facing financial models.
  • Assist with initial equity funding at transaction closings.
  • Review post-closing documentation—including Form 8609s, cost certifications, lease-up schedules, and tax returns—to update financial models.
  • Participate in tax credit adjuster calculations and provide final review as needed.
  • Implement model updates reflecting tax credit adjusters and structural changes.
  • Contribute to the training and onboarding of new analysts and underwriters.
  • Work cross-functionally on special projects requiring tax and structuring expertise.
  • Coordinate with external counsel on transaction closing schedules and structuring considerations.
  • Support Asset Management group in evaluating the impact of post-closing structural or financial changes.
  • Serve as a key feedback resource for both initial deal structuring and post-closing modifications.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Accounting (with a preference for Tax Accounting), Finance, or related field; a Master’s degree is a preference.
  • 10+ years of experience with LIHTC and knowledge of other federal tax credit programs (historic, solar, new markets); familiarity with state credit programs is a plus.
  • Extensive understanding of tax structuring issues in LIHTC transactions.
  • 10+ years of advanced Excel modeling experience, including modeling for tax-incentivized real estate deals.
  • Knowledge of real estate ownership structures and entity classifications.
  • General understanding of accounting treatment for construction costs.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills; comfortable working across multiple departments.
  • High attention to detail, ability to work independently, and confidence navigating fast-paced, deadline-driven workflows.
  • Willingness to participate as a presenter in team or company training sessions.

Salary Transparency

You will be joining a team of talented professionals motivated by serving the community and addressing the need for affordable housing.

Enterprise offers a comprehensive total rewards package for you and your family. The pay range for this position is $105,000 - $120,000. The salary range represents the low and high end of what may be paid for this position. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the pay range, and compensation decisions may be influenced by a variety of factors, including skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

Total Rewards at Enterprise

This range is just one component of our total rewards package, which also includes annual performance bonuses and generous paid leave programs.

Our benefits form a major part of the total rewards package. These include dental, health, and vision care plans, as well as family-building benefits such as adoption and surrogacy support. Enterprise supports flexible work arrangements to promote work-life balance and offers health advocacy, an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and mental health benefits. We round out our package with financial education, wellness programs, and auto-enrollment in the company’s 401(k) plan with employer matching contributions.

Finally, you will have access to learning and development opportunities, including tuition reimbursement for job-related courses and certifications. Thank you for your interest in joining the Enterprise team and contributing to our mission to serve others.
