raw.description:
The Role:

11:11 Systems is seeking a Connectivity Service Delivery Specialist to own and drive the end-to-end delivery of telecommunications services for our customers. This role is responsible for ensuring a smooth onboarding and implementation experience for connectivity services, including Dedicated Internet Access (DIA), Ethernet Private Line (EPL), Internet services, Network Interface Devices (NIDs), Public Cloud Direct-Connects, Wireless LTE, and dark fiber. This is a full-time remote role, based in the United States, reporting to the Connectivity Manager, Service Delivery.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and manage the delivery of telecommunications services and circuits, including Dedicated Internet Access (DIA), Ethernet Private Line (EPL), Internet services, Network Interface Devices (NIDs), Public Cloud Direct-Connects, Wireless LTE, and dark fiber to customer locations.
  • Own the end-to-end circuit delivery lifecycle, from order acceptance through installation, turn-up, testing, and service acceptance.
  • Manage multiple, simultaneous connectivity deployments ranging from single site installs to complex, multi-site rollouts, ensuring milestones, dependencies, and delivery timelines are met.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for customers during circuit delivery, providing proactive communication, clear expectations, and regular status updates.
  • Work cross-functionally with internal teams including Network Deployment Engineers, Project Managers, Carrier Management, and Data Center Operations, as well as external partners such as last-mile carriers, dark fiber providers, Remote Hands teams, and field technicians.
  • Coordinate, schedule, and oversee field technicians performing on-site work, including hardware installations, circuit turn-ups, testing, cross-connect verification, and troubleshooting.
  • Provide clear scope, site details, and installation instructions to carrier and third-party field technicians to ensure work is completed accurately and efficiently.
  • Coordinate and track carrier order milestones, including site surveys, local loop provisioning, cross-connects, circuit testing, and service activation.
  • Schedule and coordinate on-site activities, including carrier technicians, field tech dispatch, customer access, remote hands, and data center meet-me room or cross-connect work.
  • Manage and process MACD (Move, Add, Change, Disconnect) requests for existing circuits and connectivity services.
  • Act as a customer advocate by triaging and routing repair, billing, and service inquiries to the appropriate internal teams.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records across internal systems, ensuring circuit details, milestones, notes, and documentation are complete and auditable.
  • Proactively identify risks, delays, or dependencies and drive resolution through coordination with carriers, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Follow 11:11 Systems’ delivery standards and best practices while applying sound judgment to carrier- and site-specific challenges.
  • Foster transparency and collaboration across all teams involved in delivery, including customers, carriers, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of delivery processes by identifying gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities to improve time-to-install and customer outcomes.
  • Handle administrative and documentation tasks required to support accurate delivery, reporting, and billing readiness.
  • Work supportively with colleagues, operating in a manner that is consistent with 11:11’s Code of Business Ethics and Company Values.
  • Responsibly receive, transmit, and handle company data and information per Company data handling agreements, work procedures and policies.
  • Review and follow company policies and guidelines, data privacy practices, including annual compliance training certification and policy acknowledgements.
  • Additional duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred with 4+ years of equivalent hands-on experience in telecommunications or connectivity service delivery.
  • 2+ years of experience coordinating service delivery efforts, including managing or directing field technicians, carrier resources, and cross-functional teams.
  • Familiarity with networking devices including:
  • Routers, switches, NIDs, and SD-WAN appliances.
  • Strong working knowledge of telecommunications services and circuit delivery, including:
    • Dedicated Internet Access (DIA)
    • Ethernet services (EPL / EVPL)
    • Internet and last-mile access
    • Network Interface Devices (NIDs)
    • Dark fiber and fiber-based services
    • Public Cloud Direct-Connects
    • Wireless LTE
    • Data center cross-connects and meet-me room processes
  • Familiarity with delivery SLAs, standard installation intervals, and service activation timelines, with the ability to track progress against expectations and surface risks early.
  • Experience managing on-site installations, technician dispatch, and coordination across multiple vendors and locations.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft products, including: Microsoft and Microsoft Outlook.
  • ServiceNow experience is a plus, particularly for order tracking, workflow management, and handoff between delivery and support teams
  • Having experience in the following tools are also preferred: SharePoint, IRA, Remote Hands coordination, Field technician dispatch and oversight, ISP / OSP construction exposure, Carrier last-mile ordering and provisioning, AWS and/or other public or private cloud providers.
  • Strong customer-facing communication skills with the ability to explain complex carrier processes clearly.
  • Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple concurrent deployments.
  • Comfortable operating in a time-sensitive, high-volume delivery environment, sometimes requiring work outside of normal business hours.
  • Self-motivated, accountable, and able to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.
  • Positive attitude, high energy, and a strong desire for professional growth.
  • Must be legally eligible to work in the United States without visa sponsorship.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential function satisfactorily. The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Trusted by more than 3,000 organizations worldwide—including 75 of the Fortune 100—UserTesting delivers measurable business outcomes, reduces risk, and helps teams deliver with confidence. Joining our team means being part of a passionate group focused on transforming how companies understand and connect with their customers.

Let’s build experiences people love—together.

The Opportunity

At UserTesting, we’re the leader in human insight, helping organizations build better products and experiences by connecting them with real human perspectives. As companies increasingly build and train AI systems, our technology, participant network, and expert services uniquely position us to support this rapidly evolving space.

AI Training is a new business being incubated within UserTesting, focused on applying our expertise in sourcing and managing specialized communities to power high-quality AI training initiatives. As one of the early members of this team, you’ll have the opportunity to shape how we operate, build scalable processes from the ground up, and play a key role in growing a new business.

We’re looking for a Strategic Projects Lead to own the end-to-end delivery of AI training projects—from early customer conversations through successful execution. You’ll partner with customers, internal stakeholders, and contributor communities to solve complex operational challenges, delivering high-quality outcomes while building repeatable systems that enable future growth.

Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end delivery of AI training projects, partnering with customers from initial scoping through successful execution while assessing feasibility, timelines, operational requirements, pricing inputs, and project risks.

  • Develop and execute sourcing strategies for specialized contributor populations by leveraging UserTesting’s network, external recruiting channels, partner partnerships, and other creative approaches to meet customer needs.

  • Recruit, onboard, and manage contributor communities, designing scalable operational workflows that include onboarding, task distribution, contributor communications, quality assurance, escalations, and delivery.

  • Monitor project performance by tracking key operational metrics—including recruiting progress, activation, throughput, quality, cost, and retention—and proactively adjust plans to ensure successful outcomes.

  • Own project economics by balancing sourcing strategies, contributor compensation, staffing, quality expectations, and delivery timelines to drive efficient execution.

  • Continuously improve how the team operates by identifying opportunities to build repeatable processes, scalable systems, and operational capabilities that support the long-term growth of the AI Training business.

Requirements

  • Strong project management and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, model project performance, monitor operational metrics, and understand project economics.

  • Demonstrated ownership and problem-solving skills, with the ability to thrive in ambiguity, build processes from the ground up, and balance detailed execution with strategic thinking.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience partnering directly with customers and collaborating across cross-functional teams.

  • Familiarity with AI training concepts such as annotation, evaluations, quality assurance, reinforcement learning environments, expert data, or post-training workflows is preferred.

  • Location: Remote within the United States, with the ability to work primarily within U.S. time zones.

What You Will Do:

The Loan Review Advisor will support the U.S. Small Business Administration (SBA) Office of Credit Risk Management (OCRM) by performing detailed reviews of 7(a) and 504 loan files as part of SBA’s lender oversight and risk management activities. The role involves reviewing loan files across origination, servicing, liquidation, and targeted partial review scopes to assess compliance with SBA Loan Program Requirements as defined in 13 CFR Part 120 and applicable SBA Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). The reviewer will analyze loan documentation, identify compliance issues or deficiencies, and document findings in structured work papers and loan file review reports.

The Loan Review Senior Consultant will inventory and analyze loan files, extract and evaluate data from SBA data systems and lender-provided documentation, and identify correctable and uncorrectable exceptions. The role includes working directly with SBA Lenders, under SBA direction, to clarify documentation, resolve preliminary deficiencies when possible, and ensure lenders understand identified risks and requirements. Reviewers will prepare clear, well-supported written summaries and draft and final loan file review reports that outline condition, criteria, cause, effect, and corrective action for identified issues.

The Loan Review Senior Consultant will use a secure, web-based virtual data warehouse and workflow tracking system to manage file reviews, maintain work papers, and support status reporting. The role requires adherence to strict quality, timeliness, documentation, and data security standards, including the protection of Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and confidential business information. Reviewers may support onsite or remote reviews, participate in quality assurance activities, and contribute to weekly, monthly, or ad hoc reporting provided to SBA.

What You Will Need:

  • U.S. Citizenship and ability to obtain and maintain a federal Public Trust.

  • Bachelor's degree and Minimum of six (6) years of recent experience working with SBA 7(a) and/or 504 loans (e.g., as a third-party reviewer, examiner, auditor, underwriter, loan closer, or liquidation specialist); OR ten (10) years of relevant experience in lieu of degree.

  • Demonstrated experience reviewing loan files for compliance, risk, and adherence to regulatory and program requirements.

  • Working knowledge of SBA Loan Program Requirements, including 13 CFR Parts 103 and 120 and SBA SOPs related to origination, servicing, liquidation, and lender oversight.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify, document, and clearly explain loan file deficiencies and risks.

  • Experience preparing detailed work papers, loan file review reports, and written summaries that support defensible conclusions.

  • Ability to communicate effectively with SBA personnel and SBA Lenders, including explaining compliance issues and requirements.

  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and ability to manage multiple file reviews simultaneously while meeting delivery timelines.

  • Proficiency with document management systems, workflow tracking tools, and standard Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

What Would Be Nice To Have:

  • Direct experience supporting SBA Office of Credit Risk Management (OCRM) oversight activities, including risk-based reviews, examinations, audits, or increased supervision.

  • Experience performing servicing or liquidation reviews, including eligibility and disbursement testing.

  • Familiarity with quality assurance reviews, forensic reviews, or reviews related to fraud, waste, and abuse.

  • Experience working with virtual data warehouses, customer relationship management (CRM) systems, or management workflow systems (MWS).

  • Experience supporting federal financial regulatory or oversight programs beyond SBA.

  • Willingness and ability to support limited on-site reviews at SBA headquarters, SBA field offices, or SBA Lender locations, as required.

  • Ability to review loan files containing documentation in Spanish.

Job Title: RemoteExecutive Operations Manager & Strategic Projects Director

Job Type: Full-Time | Independent Contractor

Schedule: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM PST

About the Role:

A highly experienced Executive Operations Manager & Strategic Projects Director is needed to provide executive-level operational support to a fast-paced legal, nonprofit, and advocacy organization. This role serves as a strategic right hand to leadership, overseeing complex projects, executive operations, stakeholder coordination, and organizational initiatives across multiple business functions.

The ideal candidate is a proactive operator who can independently manage priorities, build systems, coordinate high-level initiatives, and drive execution with minimal oversight. This position requires exceptional organizational skills, executive presence, sound judgment, and the ability to manage multiple projects while maintaining attention to detail.

This is not a traditional administrative support role. The position requires someone capable of thinking strategically, anticipating needs, solving problems proactively, and ensuring key initiatives move forward efficiently.

Key Responsibilities:

Executive Operations & Strategic Support

  • Serve as a strategic partner to leadership across business, legal, and nonprofit initiatives
  • Protect executive time through effective calendar, priority, and workflow management
  • Coordinate high-level projects and ensure deadlines, deliverables, and priorities remain on track
  • Draft executive communications, reports, presentations, and internal documentation
  • Anticipate operational needs and proactively implement solutions

Project & Event Management

  • Lead operational planning and execution of conferences, summits, board meetings, and special initiatives
  • Coordinate vendors, venues, stakeholders, attendees, and project timelines
  • Manage project plans, budgets, logistics, and implementation schedules
  • Monitor project progress and resolve operational challenges proactively
  • Ensure successful execution of high-visibility events and strategic initiatives

Operations & Organizational Management

  • Build and improve systems, workflows, dashboards, and operational processes
  • Develop SOPs, reporting structures, and project management frameworks
  • Track organizational metrics, goals, and operational performance
  • Coordinate cross-functional initiatives among internal and external stakeholders
  • Identify process improvement opportunities and implement scalable solutions

Stakeholder & Executive Communications

  • Act as a professional point of contact for executives, board members, partners, vendors, and external organizations
  • Coordinate communications with strategic partners and community stakeholders
  • Support board initiatives, coalition activities, and organizational programs
  • Prepare meeting materials, summaries, and executive briefings
  • Maintain confidentiality and professionalism when handling sensitive information

Personal & Administrative Operations Support

  • Assist with executive travel coordination and logistical planning
  • Research, vet, and coordinate service providers and vendors when needed
  • Manage personal administrative projects and special requests
  • Handle high-level administrative responsibilities that support executive productivity
  • Ensure seamless coordination across professional and personal priorities

Must-Have

  • Strong project management and operational leadership experience
  • Experience managing complex projects, events, or organizational initiatives
  • Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills
  • Strong executive presence and stakeholder management abilities
  • Experience creating SOPs, workflows, dashboards, and operational systems
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and exercise sound judgment
  • High level of discretion and professionalism when handling confidential information
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment

Preferred

  • Fully remote role
  • Full-time schedule aligned with Pacific Standard Time (PST)
  • Fast-paced, mission-driven environment
  • High level of executive exposure and strategic involvement
  • Opportunity to influence organizational growth and operational excellence
  • Collaborative environment supporting legal, nonprofit, advocacy, and leadership initiatives
  • Long-term opportunity for growth into broader strategic operations leadership responsibilities

Working Environment:

  • Fully remote role supporting a U.S.-based solo legal practice.
  • Part-time schedule initially (approximately 20 hours per week) with potential to increase to full-time.
  • Work hours aligned with U.S. business hours (late morning to early afternoon Eastern Time preferred).
  • Collaborative working relationship with the attorney to support daily legal operations.

The Opportunity

Alliance Solutions Group is a leading Sage Intacct partner for the construction industry and a fast-growing, PE-backed professional services organization. As Alliance continues to scale, we are investing in the leadership, infrastructure, and insights needed to support our next stage of growth.

We are looking for a Senior Director of Finance to serve as a strategic business partner to our leadership team and help shape how we plan, measure, and make decisions across the business. This role sits at the intersection of financial planning, business intelligence, and business strategy—translating financial and operational data into clear insights that help leaders understand performance, evaluate opportunities, and make informed decisions.

The right leader will bring an Alliance-first mindset and a strong understanding of how Finance can enable the broader business. They will partner closely with leaders across the organization, bring a thoughtful financial perspective to strategic conversations, and proactively identify opportunities to improve performance and create value. Success in this role requires someone who can move comfortably between the details and the bigger picture—building strong financial discipline while helping Alliance scale with confidence.

This is a fully remote role with quarterly travel for Leadership offsites and report directly to the CEO and sit on the Executive Leadership team.

Read more about the Alliance Team in our People Behind the Build Blog Series.

What You’ll Own

Strategic Business Partnership

  • Serve as a strategic advisor to the leadership team, bringing a financial and business perspective to company planning, investment decisions, organizational priorities, and growth initiatives.
  • Act as the financial business partner to department leaders, developing a deep understanding of their operations, challenges, and opportunities. Translate financial and operational data into actionable insights that help leaders make stronger, faster decisions.
  • Work closely with the Head of People & Organizational Effectiveness on workforce and organizational planning, including headcount strategy, organizational design, role changes, and resource allocation. Together, connect the financial and people implications of organizational decisions to ensure investments support both business performance and long-term scalability.
  • Bring financial rigor to strategic initiatives and new opportunities. Build business cases, model scenarios, assess ROI and risk, and clearly articulate tradeoffs so leadership can make informed decisions about where and how Alliance invests for growth.

Financial Planning & Analysis

You are comfortable operating in a growing organization where priorities evolve and leaders are expected to help shape the path forward.

Nice-to-Haves

Bilingual Full-Cycle Sales Representative

Position Type: Full-Time | Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, we are hiring for one of our clients seeking a Bilingual Full-Cycle Sales Representative to join their growing sales team.

This role is ideal for a proven salesperson who knows how to manage a pipeline, conduct consultative sales conversations, handle objections, follow up consistently, and close deals.

You do not need experience in international moving. The client will provide training on the industry, services, and processes. What matters most is that you already know how to sell.

The ideal candidate is confident taking ownership of opportunities from the initial conversation through quoting, negotiation, follow-up, and close.

Responsibilities

Sales & Lead Management

  • Respond to and engage with new leads through the company's lead management system.
  • Conduct discovery conversations to understand customer needs, timelines, destinations, and requirements.
  • Manage opportunities throughout the complete sales cycle.
  • Maintain consistent follow-up with prospects and open opportunities.
  • Prioritize leads based on buying intent, customer needs, and revenue potential.

Consultative Selling & Closing

  • Ask effective discovery questions to identify customer needs and buying motivations.
  • Present solutions based on each customer's specific requirements.
  • Prepare and explain quotes clearly and professionally.
  • Handle objections and communicate the value of the company's services.
  • Negotiate appropriately and guide qualified prospects toward a decision.
  • Identify buying signals and use effective closing techniques.
  • Convert qualified opportunities into booked business.

Pipeline & CRM Management

  • Take complete ownership of the sales pipeline from lead engagement through close.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records, notes, follow-ups, and opportunity stages.
  • Ensure qualified opportunities are consistently followed up with.
  • Keep customer information and sales activity up to date.
  • Manage multiple opportunities while maintaining strong attention to detail.

Client & Internal Coordination

  • Build strong relationships with prospects throughout the sales process.
  • Communicate pricing, services, expectations, and timelines clearly.
  • Coordinate with internal pricing and operations teams when needed.
  • Ensure proposed solutions align with customer requirements and service capabilities.
  • Maintain proactive communication with both customers and internal teams.

What Makes You a Perfect Fit

  • You already know how to sell—you don't need to be taught the fundamentals of sales.
  • You have experience taking prospects through a sales process and closing business.
  • You are confident conducting discovery calls and asking the right questions.
  • You are comfortable handling objections, negotiating, and asking for the sale.
  • You are persistent with follow-up and do not need to be reminded to move opportunities forward.
  • You take ownership of your pipeline and are accountable for your results.
  • You are motivated by performance and commission-based earning potential.
  • You are comfortable working with warm/inbound leads and, ideally, outbound opportunities.
  • You can quickly learn a new industry and become knowledgeable about the product or service.
  • You are organized, proactive, and comfortable working independently.
  • You communicate confidently in both English and Spanish.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of proven sales experience preferred, with strong candidates demonstrating exceptional sales performance considered.
  • Demonstrated experience managing opportunities through the sales process.
  • Proven ability to handle objections, follow up consistently, and close deals.
  • Strong consultative and needs-based selling skills.
  • Experience using a CRM or sales pipeline management system.
  • Strong computer literacy and ability to work across multiple systems.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Fluent or professional Spanish.
  • Comfortable working U.S. business hours.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal sales coaching or supervision.

Typical Day

  • Review and prioritize new and existing leads.
  • Conduct discovery calls with prospective customers.
  • Understand customer needs and recommend appropriate solutions.
  • Prepare and follow up on quotes and proposals.
  • Handle objections and negotiate with qualified prospects.
  • Follow up with open opportunities and move them toward a decision.
  • Coordinate with pricing and operations teams when necessary.
  • Update CRM records and pipeline stages.
  • Close qualified opportunities and contribute to weekly booking targets.
  • Continuously manage and improve your sales pipeline.

Compensation & Earning Potential

  • Base Salary: Starting around $1,000 USD/month.
  • Commission: Performance-based commission tied to the profitability of booked business.
  • Commission earnings increase based on sales performance and booking volume.
  • Typical production expectations are approximately $5,000–$8,000 in weekly bookings.
  • Strong performers have meaningful opportunity to increase their monthly earnings through commission.

This role is designed for sales professionals who are motivated by performance and want their earning potential to grow alongside their results.

Interview Process

  • Initial screening with Pavago.
  • Client interview.
  • Final selection and onboarding.

Professor Avaliador de STEM (Física para o Ensino Médio no Brasil) - Meio Período

Local: Remoto

Contrato: Projeto de curto prazo, em meio período, com duração de dois meses

Data de início (compromisso de tempo): Imediato (expectativa de 1 a 2 horas por mês)

Idiomas: Inglês, Português do Brasil

Sobre nós

O Efekta Education Group é líder mundial em tecnologia de aprendizagem baseada em IA para professores e alunos. Redefinimos a educação com soluções inovadoras que proporcionam melhores resultados de aprendizagem em larga escala, em todos os lugares, ajudando os alunos a progredirem mais rapidamente e a irem mais longe em sistemas de ensino públicos e privados, universidades e empresas globais. Até o momento, a tecnologia da Efekta já ensinou inglês para mais de 24 milhões de pessoas e é atualmente utilizada por mais de quatro milhões de alunos ativos, 25.000 professores, 3.000 clientes corporativos e diversos governos em todo o mundo.

Resumo da função

Buscamos professores de Física do Ensino Médio da rede pública brasileira para avaliar nosso novo protótipo de aula interativa de STEM. Você testará a aula, compartilhará feedback e nos ajudará a aprimorar a experiência de aprendizado para alunos do Ensino Médio brasileiro.

Esta é uma vaga flexível, em regime de meio período, que pode ser realizada remotamente.

A vaga terá início imediato após a aprovação da sua candidatura e terá duração de dois meses, encerrando-se automaticamente em seguida.

Responsabilidades:

  • Testar e explorar o novo protótipo da aula de Física online.
  • Fornecer feedback claro sobre:
  • Precisão do conteúdo
  • Usabilidade e experiência do aluno
  • Alinhamento com o BNCC e as necessidades do Ensino Médio
  • Sugestões de melhoria
  • Participar de breves sessões de feedback (online).
  • Responder a um breve questionário de avaliação.
  • Participar de reuniões com a equipe de Design de Aprendizagem da Efekta.

Requisitos

  • Lecionar Física em uma escola pública de ensino médio no Brasil (obrigatório)
  • Familiaridade com o BNCC para Ensino Médio (Física)
  • Conforto com ferramentas de aprendizagem digital e plataformas online
  • Seus alunos usam a Khan Academy para Física
  • Capacidade de fornecer feedback construtivo e prático
  • O que oferecemos
  • Remuneração pelo seu tempo
  • Horário flexível: participe quando for conveniente para você
  • Oportunidade de influenciar uma inovação educacional em nível nacional
  • Certificado de participação (se solicitado)

raw.title: Logistics Diminishing Supplies Specialist
raw.excerpt: Shape the future of defense with MANTECH!  Join a team dedicated to safeguarding our nation through advanced tech and innovative solutions.
raw.description:
Shape the future of defense with MANTECH! Join a team dedicated to safeguarding our nation through advanced tech and innovative solutions. Since 1968, we’ve been a trusted partner to the Department of Defense, delivering cutting-edge projects that make a real impact. Dive into exciting opportunities in Cybersecurity, IT, Data Analytics and more. Propel your career forward and be part of something extraordinary. Your journey starts now—protect and innovate with MANTECH!

Job Description

MANTECH seeks a motivated, career and customer-oriented Logistics Diminishing Supplies Specialist to join our team in Lakehurst, NJ. This position is a remoteposition.

The Logistics Specialist will leverage their strong technical background and knowledge to support the Aircraft Launch and Recovery Equipment (ALRE) Department, providing general Integrated Logistics Support (ILS) and supply chain expertise for the Electromagnetic Aircraft Launch System (EMALS) and Advanced Arresting Gear (AAG) programs. This role supports ship configuration management, lifecycle logistics, and provisioning analysis to ensure fleet readiness.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Reviewing DoD ILS data, provisioning details, and spare parts availability while conducting diminishing manufacturing sources and material shortages (DMSMS) tracking

  • Maintaining comprehensive spreadsheets and tracking databases containing critical vendor data, lead times, end-of-life cycles, and required quantities for lifetime buys

  • Reviewing Bills of Materials (BOM) and participating in critical stakeholder meetings to research, analyze, and manage entries into the ships' Allowance Parts Listings (APL)

  • Supporting APMLs and DAPMLs by execution of assigned lifecycle logistics tasks, process tracking, and budget preparation activities

  • Attending all assigned EMALS, AAG, and ALRE meetings as a logistics subject matter expert to communicate requirements across the military and government chain of command

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university with 3+ years of experience in DoD systems lifecycle logistics support; an additional five 5+ years of relevant DOD logistics support for entire life cycle related to DOD systems experience may be substituted in lieu of degree

  • Experience reviewing Bills of Materials (BOM) and Allowance Parts Listings (APL) to identify parts for diminishing supplies analysis and engineering change proposals (ECP)

  • Experience with DoD ILS, provisioning, supply chain management, and configuration management processes and databases

  • Experience working across teams to communicate lifecycle data and track logistics requirements for complex systems

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Aircraft Launch and Recovery Equipment (ALRE) programs or Navy logistics automation tools

  • Experience attending Systems Engineering Technical Review (SETR) events and evaluating ECPs for spare parts candidates

  • Self-starter with excellent people skills able to source alternate vendors and maintain data tracking logs for critical lifetime buys

Clearance Requirements:

  • Must be a US Citizen and possess a current or active Secret Security Clearance

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50%.

  • Needs to occasionally move about inside the office and physically navigate aircraft carriers, flight decks, compartments, and stairwells.

  • Frequently communicates with co-workers, management, and customers, which may involve delivering presentations and verbal or email correspondences.

  • Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.


The projected compensation range for this position is $58,000.00-$95,900.00. There are differentiating factors that can impact a final salary/hourly rate, including, but not limited to, Contract Wage Determination, relevant work experience, skills and competencies that align to the specified role, geographic location (For Remote Opportunities), education and certifications as well as Federal Government Contract Labor categories. In addition, MANTECH invests in its employees beyond just compensation. MANTECH’s benefits offerings include, dependent upon position, Health Insurance, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, Holiday Pay, short-term and long-term Disability, Retirement and Savings, Learning and Development opportunities, wellness programs as well as other optional benefit elections.

MANTECH considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to disability or veteran status or any other status protected under any federal, state, or local law or regulation.

If you need a reasonable accommodation to apply for a position with MANTECH, please email us at and provide your name and contact information.

Lyric is an AI-first, platform-based healthcare technology company, committed to simplifying the business of care by preventing inaccurate payments and reducing overall waste in the healthcare ecosystem, enabling more efficient use of resources to reduce the cost of care for payers, providers, and patients. Lyric, formerly ClaimsXten, is a market leader with 35 years of pre-pay editing expertise, dedicated teams, and top technology. Lyric is proud to be recognized as 2025 Best in KLAS for Pre-Payment Accuracy and Integrity and is HI-TRUST and SOC2 certified, and a recipient of the 2025 CandE Award for Candidate Experience. Interested in shaping the future of healthcare with AI? Explore opportunities at lyric.ai/careers and drive innovation with #YouToThePowerOfAI.

The Senior Manager, Corporate IT serves as the senior technical leader for the Corporate IT organization, reporting directly to the Director of IT. This role is responsible for driving the technical execution, operational excellence, and continuous modernization of Corporate IT services across Infrastructure, End User Computing, Identity & Access Management, Enterprise Applications, and Service Management.

This is a highly hands-on leadership role focused on technology rather than day-to-day personnel management. The Senior Manager partners with the Service Desk, Systems, Enterprise Applications, and IAM team to provide technical direction, establish engineering standards, remove technical roadblocks, and ensure reliable delivery of enterprise technology services.

The successful candidate is expected to lead complex technical initiatives, architect enterprise solutions, drive automation, improve operational maturity, and serve as the highest technical escalation point within Corporate IT. This individual will help shape the organization's technology roadmap while enabling the Director of IT to focus on strategic planning, financial management, governance, mergers and acquisitions, and executive engagement.

ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES & KEY PERFORMANCE OUTCOMES

Technical Leadership

  • Serve as the senior technical authority across Corporate IT.

  • Provide architectural guidance for Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Intune, endpoint management, networking, identity, enterprise applications, and cloud services.

  • Review and approve technical designs, infrastructure changes, and operational standards.

  • Mentor technical leads and senior engineers while fostering engineering excellence across the organization.

  • Act as the primary technical advisor to the Director of IT.

Infrastructure & Cloud Operations

  • Lead the modernization of Microsoft 365 and Azure environments.

  • Oversee endpoint management, device lifecycle, and enterprise mobility solutions.

  • Ensure high availability, resiliency, scalability, and security of Corporate IT infrastructure.

  • Guide disaster recovery, backup, capacity planning, and technology lifecycle initiatives.

Identity & Security

  • Partner with IAM leadership to improve identity governance, lifecycle management, and Zero Trust security.

  • Support implementation of Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and identity automation.

  • Ensure technology solutions align with corporate security policies and compliance requirements.

Enterprise Applications

  • Partner with Enterprise Applications leadership to ensure reliable delivery of business-critical platforms including Microsoft 365, Workday, Salesforce, NetSuite, Jira Service Management, and other enterprise SaaS solutions.

  • Provide technical leadership for enterprise integrations, APIs, authentication, and platform architecture.

Operational Excellence

  • Drive operational maturity across Corporate IT.

  • Establish technical standards, documentation, and governance processes.

  • Lead major incident response, root cause analysis, and post-incident reviews.

  • Identify opportunities to improve service quality, reliability, and operational efficiency.

Automation & AI

  • Lead enterprise automation initiatives utilizing PowerShell, Power Platform, APIs, Infrastructure as Code, and AI technologies.

  • Reduce manual processes through automation and workflow optimization.

  • Champion the adoption of AI-enabled IT operations and productivity tools.

Project & Program Leadership

  • Lead cross-functional technology initiatives from planning through implementation.

  • Coordinate technical delivery across Service Desk, Systems, IAM, and Enterprise Applications.

  • Identify technical risks, dependencies, and mitigation strategies.

  • Support technology integration activities related to acquisitions and organizational growth.

Vendor & Technology Management

  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions that improve business outcomes.

  • Provide technical oversight for strategic vendors and technology partners.

  • Assist with technology selection, lifecycle planning, and platform standardization.

Key Impact Metrics

Success in this role will be measured by:

  • Increased stability and availability of Corporate IT services.

  • Reduction in recurring incidents through root cause elimination.

  • Increased automation of operational and administrative processes.

  • Successful delivery of strategic technology initiatives on schedule and within scope.

  • Adoption of enterprise technology standards and best practices.

  • Reduced technical debt through modernization efforts.

  • Improved operational efficiency across Corporate IT.

  • Strong collaboration across Service Desk, Systems, Enterprise Applications, and IAM.

  • High customer satisfaction and service reliability.

  • Development of technical capabilities within Corporate IT teams.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in enterprise information technology.

  • Minimum of 5 years leading enterprise technical teams or technology functions.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Demonstrated experience leading complex enterprise infrastructure, cloud environments, and modernization initiatives.

  • Extensive experience with Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Active Directory, and enterprise endpoint management.

  • Experience supporting enterprise SaaS platforms, including Workday, Salesforce, NetSuite, Jira Service Management, and Atlassian products.

  • Strong understanding of networking, identity, security, cloud architecture, and systems administration.

  • Hands-on experience with PowerShell scripting, enterprise automation, Infrastructure as Code, and DevOps practices.

  • Experience leading major technical incidents and complex enterprise technology initiatives.

  • Proven ability to develop technical standards, operational processes, architectural best practices, and technology roadmaps.

  • Experience with AI-assisted IT Operations (AIOps), Microsoft Copilot, or enterprise AI platforms.

  • Experience leading technology integration activities associated with mergers and acquisitions.

  • Experience working within regulated industries or environments with strong security and compliance requirements.

  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and executive audiences.

  • Relevant professional certifications preferred, including Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Administrator Associate, Identity and Access Administrator Associate, Endpoint Administrator Associate, ITIL Foundation/Managing Professional, CISSP, Security+, or equivalent certifications.

$150,289.00 - $225,434.00

raw.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Why work at Nebius

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud computing to serve the global AI economy. We create the tools and resources our customers need to solve real-world challenges and transform industries, without massive infrastructure costs or the need to build large in-house AI/ML teams. Our employees work at the cutting edge of AI cloud infrastructure alongside some of the most experienced and innovative leaders and engineers in the field.

Where we work

Headquartered in Amsterdam and listed on Nasdaq, Nebius has a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, North America, and Israel. The team of over 1500 employees includes more than 400 highly skilled engineers with deep expertise across hardware and software engineering, as well as an in-house hardware R&D team.

The team

You will join a small, highly focused frontend engineering team responsible for building internal interfaces that power Nebius’s GPU cloud and data center operations. The team develops tools that automate infrastructure deployment, server operations, network management, and logistics workflows across global data center environments.

This role is part of the wider infrastructure and operations organization and works closely with engineering teams responsible for cloud infrastructure, deployment automation, and production operations.

The role

We are seeking a Senior Frontend Engineer – User Interface to design and build internal platforms that support automation and operational management across Nebius data centers and GPU cloud infrastructure.

This is a highly autonomous role focused on developing reliable, scalable user interfaces for infrastructure-heavy environments. You will work across systems related to server operations, network management, logistics, and deployment workflows while partnering closely with infrastructure and operations teams.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Designing and developing internal web applications that automate data center and infrastructure operations.
  • Building user interfaces that support server management, network operations, deployment workflows, and logistics processes.
  • Collaborating with infrastructure, operations, and platform engineering teams to translate operational requirements into scalable frontend solutions.
  • Improving reliability, usability, and operational efficiency across internal tooling platforms.
  • Working closely with European-based frontend engineers to align on architecture, standards, and development practices.
  • Supporting deployment and operational workflows across GPU cloud infrastructure environments.
  • Contributing to frontend architecture decisions, component design, and long-term maintainability of internal systems.
  • Participating in code reviews, technical discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives across the engineering organization.

We expect you to have:

  • Strong experience with JavaScript and/or TypeScript.
  • Hands-on experience building modern frontend applications using React.
  • Experience working with Docker and containerized development environments.
  • Strong Linux knowledge and command-line proficiency.
  • Experience supporting, deploying, or troubleshooting applications in production infrastructure environments.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to operate independently in high-responsibility environments.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across distributed teams and time zones.
  • A proactive, ownership-driven mindset with strong communication skills.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with frontend state management libraries and patterns.
  • Background working in infrastructure, cloud, or data center environments.
  • Familiarity with deployment automation or operational tooling.
  • Experience building internal developer or operations-focused platforms.

Pay Transparency

We offer competitive compensation and benefits packages. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, the level at which the candidate is hired, and geographic location, consistent with applicable law.

Base Compensation Range
$122,880—$184,320 USD

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

raw.description:
Veregy is an award-winning NAESCO-Accredited decarbonization company focusing on accelerating and simplifying Energy Transition. We provide turnkey engineering and construction services designed to reduce our clients' energy and operating costs through the implementation of energy efficiency and infrastructure upgrades, smart building technology, fleet EV infrastructure, clean energy generation, and sustainability.

Do you want to be part of a TEAM who delivers Eco-Friendly Environments that Transform Lives? Then you are in the right place…start the application process today!

Summary of Position Functions

The Manager of Area Sales is responsible for leading the sales strategy, revenue growth, market development, and sales performance across an assigned multi-state territory. This position has the overall responsibility for achieving annual sales objectives, developing and executing territory growth strategies, maintaining a strong and predictable sales pipeline, and ensuring sales activities support the Company’s revenue and profitability goals.

The Manager of Area Sales leads, coaches, and develops a team of sales professionals while maintaining direct involvement in strategic accounts, major pursuits, and key customer relationships. The position works collaboratively with operational, engineering, estimating, finance, marketing, and executive leadership to identify market opportunities, develop competitive solutions, improve win rates, and ensure successful transition of awarded opportunities from sales to execution.

Essential Position Functions

Enterprise Sales and Commercial Growth Strategy

  • Owns sales strategy, revenue performance, and market growth for the assigned muti-state territory.
  • Develops and executes annual and multi-year territory sales plans aligned with Company growth, revenue, profitability, and strategic objectives.
  • Establishes annual sales targets and translates territory objectives into measurable individual and team goals.
  • Identifies market trends, competitive threats, customer needs, and emerging opportunities and adjusts sales strategies accordingly.
  • Develops strategies to increase market penetration, expand existing customer relationships, enter new markets, and generate recurring business.
  • Evaluates territory performance against established objectives and implements corrective action when revenue, pipeline, margin, or other performance expectations are at risk.
  • Partners with executive leadership in developing territory growth priorities, resource requirements, and strategic initiatives.

Pipeline Management, Forecasting, and Sales Performance

  • Maintains a healthy, diversified, and appropriately weighted sales pipeline sufficient to support current and future revenue objectives.
  • Establishes and monitors sales KPIs, including pipeline development, opportunity progression, win rates, sales cycle, forecast accuracy, bookings, and other applicable performance measures.
  • Provides timely and accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual sales forecasts to executive leadership.
  • Conducts regular pipeline and opportunity reviews to assess probability, timing, competitive position, next steps, and barriers to closing.
  • Ensures sales opportunities, customer activities, forecasts, and relevant account information are accurately and consistently maintained within the Company's CRM system.
  • Uses sales and market data to identify performance trends and develops action plans to address gaps.
  • Drives accountability for consistent execution of the Company's sales processes and standards.

Sales Team Leadership and Development

  • Leads, coaches, mentors, and develops sales professionals throughout the assigned territory.
  • Establishes clear individual and team performance expectations aligned with territory objectives.
  • Conducts regular one-on-one meetings, pipeline reviews, sales coaching sessions, and performance evaluations.
  • Coaches team members on prospecting, account development, opportunity qualification, customer engagement, presentations, negotiations, and closing strategies.
  • Identifies individual development needs and establishes appropriate coaching and professional-development plans.
  • Recognizes high performance and addresses performance deficiencies in a timely and consistent manner.
  • Participates in workforce planning, recruiting, interviewing, selection, onboarding, and retention of sales talent.
  • Promotes collaboration, accountability, ethical sales practices, and a high-performance sales culture across the territory.

Strategic Accounts and Business Development

  • Personally develops and maintains relationships with key customers, strategic accounts, and senior-level decision-makers.
  • Identifies and pursues major commercial, industrial, institutional, municipal, utility, and other strategic opportunities appropriate to the Company's business.
  • Develops relationships with facility owners, executives, utilities, contractors, engineering firms, consultants, channel partners, and other industry stakeholders.
  • Develops strategic account plans designed to strengthen customer relationships, increase customer retention, and identify additional revenue opportunities.
  • Supports sales professionals on complex or high-value pursuits, including customer strategy, executive engagement, presentations, negotiations, and closing activities.
  • Represents the Company at customer meetings, industry associations, conferences, trade shows, networking events, and other business-development activities as appropriate.
  • Monitors competitive activity and develops strategies to strengthen the Company's market position.

Opportunity Strategy and Commercial Management

  • Provides leadership and oversight for major sales opportunities from initial qualification through contract award and transition to operations.
  • Evaluates opportunities based on strategic fit, customer need, competitive position, probability of success, revenue potential, profitability, resource requirements, and risk.
  • Partners with estimating, engineering, operations, finance, legal, and other internal stakeholders to develop competitive and financially responsible customer solutions.
  • Participates in pricing, proposal, and pursuit strategy for significant opportunities.
  • Supports contract negotiations and works with appropriate internal resources to address commercial terms, customer requirements, and business risks.
  • Maintains appropriate focus on both revenue growth and the quality and profitability of sales.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serves as a key liaison between the sales organization and operations, engineering, estimating, finance, marketing, and executive leadership.
  • Ensures effective communication and coordination throughout the sales process.
  • Facilitates effective handoff of awarded opportunities from sales to project execution teams.
  • Communicates customer expectations, commitments, scope considerations, and other relevant information to internal stakeholders.
  • Works collaboratively to resolve issues that could affect customer relationships, opportunity progression, or future business.
  • Provides market and customer feedback to leadership to support strategic planning, service development, and organizational decision-making.

Customer and Market Leadership

  • Develops a strong understanding of the assigned territory, including customer segments, competitors, market conditions, regulatory considerations, and industry trends.
  • Maintains awareness of factors affecting customer capital planning, energy and infrastructure investments, procurement strategies, and purchasing decisions.
  • Serves as an executive-level representative of the Company with key customers and strategic partners.
  • Builds long-term customer relationships based on credibility, responsiveness, and an understanding of customer business objectives.
  • Supports customer retention and expansion strategies and assists in resolving significant customer concerns when appropriate.
  • Note: The statements contained herein describe the essential functions of this position but should not be an all-inclusive listing of work requirements. Individuals may perform other duties as assigned including work in other areas to cover absences or relief to equalize peak work periods or otherwise balance the workload.

Non-Essential Position Functions

  • Other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • Directly supervises employees in the Sales department and may provide leadership and direction to other employees involved in sales pursuits and business-development activities. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with Veregy’s policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints, and resolving problems.

Education and Qualifications

To perform this position successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, Construction Management, Energy Management, or a related field preferred; or an equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant professional experience.
  • Minimum of seven (7) years of progressively responsible sales, business development, account management, or related commercial experience, preferably within energy services, energy efficiency, construction, engineering, building systems, infrastructure, or related industry.
  • Minimum of three (3) years of sales leadership or people-management experience, including responsibility for coaching, developing, and managing the performance of sales professionals.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing sales strategies across a defined geographic territory or multiple markets.
  • Proven track record of achieving significant sales or revenue targets and developing a sustainable pipeline of qualified opportunities.
  • Experience managing complex, consultative, and/or solution-based sales involving multiple stakeholders and extended sales cycles.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining relationships with executive-level customers and key decision-makers.
  • Experience with strategic account planning, territory management, pipeline management, sales forecasting, and opportunity qualification.
  • Experience leading major sales pursuits, including customer discovery, solution development, proposal strategy, presentations, negotiations, and closing activities.
  • Experience working collaboratively with operational, technical, estimating, finance, legal, and executive teams to develop and close complex opportunities.
  • Experience using CRM systems to manage opportunities, sales activity, pipeline, forecasting, and performance metrics.
  • Experience within commercial, industrial, K-12, higher education, healthcare, state and local government, municipal, utility, or other institutional markets preferred.
  • Experience with energy performance contracting, design-build, energy efficiency, renewable energy, distributed energy, facility modernization, or related solutions is preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Knowledge of Veregy’s services and processes is required which can be obtained through intellect, technical inclination, and dedication to gain such knowledge.
  • Knowledge (Intermediate to advanced) of various operating systems, software products (e.g. MS Office, etc.), is required.
  • Computer software proficiency including Microsoft Project, Viewpoint, RS Means, Trimble Estimating and / or other job-related hardware and software applications that may be required.
  • Ability to work independently and efficiently manage time / workload.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret financial reports, business, professional, and technical documents.
  • Ability to effectively respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers and staff.
  • Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form.
  • Ability to write presentations, articles, routine reports, proposals, and correspondence.
  • Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts and percentages.
  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
  • Ability to interpret an extensive variety of instructions and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and tactfully negotiate priority with end users.
  • Ability to work under deadline pressure and extra hours if needed.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations

  • Valid driver’s license required.

Benefits

  • Competitive Compensation.
  • Paid Holidays, Paid Sick Leave, and Paid Time Off.
  • Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision Plans.
  • 401k Retirement Plan with Matching Employer Contributions (%).
  • Employer Sponsored Life Insurance and AD&D Insurance.
  • Employer Paid Short- and Long-Term Disability Insurance.
  • Continued Education and Trade Certification Sponsorship (Specific Positions).
  • Company Branded Trucks Provided (Specific Positions).

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

raw.description:
UFG is currently seeking a Lead General Adjuster - Field who will be responsible for handling Regional, and as needed, company-wide large property losses.  The adjuster is responsible for determining the exposure, evaluating the loss and bring about a timely resolution.  In addition to providing exceptional customer service, this adjuster is responsible for controlling expenses and eliminating leakage associated with large property losses.  This adjuster will serve as the CAT Coordinator for designated catastrophes. 

**The ideal candidate will be located in Dallas, TX area**

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Handle large property losses within the region or elsewhere as needed in adherence with Claims Best Practices & Claims Gold Standard reserving.
  • CAT coordinator for designated catastrophe in compliance with UFG’s Catastrophe Plan.
  • Responsible for the oversight of UFG’s Catastrophe Plan and an annual review and update as needed.
  • Daily CAT duties include monitoring Catography reports for CAT activity.
  • Serve as a property training resource including assisting in new hire training, regional property training and as a general subject matter expert

Job Specifications:

Education:

  • 4-year college degree preferred
  • AIC, SCLA or PCLA of the AEI series (If the adjuster does not have a designation, one will be completed within 3 years.)
  • The willingness and ability to be involved in continuing education relevant to the position/duties.
  • Meet the appropriate state licensing laws and requirements.

Experience:

  • 10 years of property claims experience

Knowledge, skills & abilities:

  • Self-motivated individual with a good command of time management and ability to function with little supervision.
  • Strong technical, analytical and investigative skills.
  • Appropriate computer skills and estimating software skills.
  • Solid written, verbal communication, and presentation skills.
  • Strong soft and customer service skills.
  • Ability to work and function in a team environment.
  • Demonstrate leadership capabilities.

Working Conditions:

  • This position will frequently require irregular hours to complete assigned claim, inclusive of evenings and weekends. It will require overnight travel, including assignment to catastrophes.
  • Ability to work independently and from a remote home office.
  • Travel estimated up to 50% of the time and on short notice.
  • Physical requirements of the job include working outside, lifting 40 lbs.

Pay Transparency Statement:

UFG Insurance is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The base salary range for this position is $103,221 - $136,105 annually, which represents the typical range for new hires in this role. Individual pay within this range will be determined based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, education, certifications, skills, internal equity, geography and market data.

In addition to base salary, UFG Insurance offers a comprehensive total rewards package that includes:

  • Annual incentive compensation
  • Medical, dental, vision & life insurance
  • Accident, critical Illness & short-term disability insurance
  • Retirement plans with employer contributions
  • Generous time-off program
  • Programs designed to support the employee well-being and financial security.

This pay range disclosure is provided in accordance with applicable state and local pay transparency laws.

raw.description:
Position Purpose:

Oversee the product development function, including formulating product vision and strategy, defining future product needs and enhancements, and driving the creation of profitable, highly engaging, easy-to-use products across all business units.

  • Lead enterprise UM portfolio strategy and governance, partnering with clinical technology vendors and product development partners to align roadmap priorities, enforce SLA accountability, and drive end-to-end delivery across prior authorization, concurrent review, and clinical correspondence workflows.
  • Drive deployment of AI-enabled and other Tech capabilities across the UM lifecycle, from intake through determination and correspondence, establishing operational effectiveness frameworks that measure productivity, accuracy, and throughput gains to enable scalable, compliant automation.
  • Own the enterprise ROI and KPI measurement framework for UM technology investments and strategic initiatives, delivering executive-ready reporting on financial performance, vendor outcomes, and AI impact to inform senior leadership decision-making.
  • Develop and oversee the model for managing product development strategy.
  • Develop and oversee product roadmap in alignment with company strategic goals, market trends, competitive landscape, client, and consumer needs.
  • Drive clinical, digital and data/analytics product innovation ensuring highly engaging products with high ease of use.
  • Partner with strategic business unit team leadership (Operations, Pharma sales, Provider Sales and Account Management) and portfolio management to plan and manage complex set of priorities and resources to meet dynamic business, client, and market needs.
  • Build an effective and efficient product organization, including product management, consumer engagement, strategic partnerships and innovation.
  • Drive efficiency within the RFP and client implementation processes.
  • Review market landscape, analyze usage of product offerings, and review business case and key metrics to ensure ROI.
  • Monitor and measure product competitiveness and support new business opportunities.
  • Manage, measure and monitor strategic partners.

You’ll translate data and media learnings into clear decisions, run practical innovations, and scale what works. Client‑Centric

  • Pair strong TVAD craft (audience/data sources, inventory quality, frequency/overlap control, brand safety/attention) with growing multi‑channel understanding

Data & Measurement‑Driven

  • Design valid tests suited to TVAD (geo/lift or holdout where feasible; otherwise powered A/B or time‑series), define success thresholds up front, and keep a steady read cadence; forecast expected impact and risk.

Owner Mindset

  • Move fast, keep promises, and remove recurring sources of waste (e.g., unmanaged frequency, low‑quality inventory, overlap

  • Help your Pod adopt better ways of working.

  • Greatness attracts greatness:Keep improving your craft; embrace new tools and AI.

  • Culture of ownership:Move fast, cut waste, and own the result end‑to‑end.

Professional & Technical Qualifications

  • Experience: 5–7 years managing TV/video/audio/display at scale (CTV/OTT/Linear, online video, digital audio/podcasts, programmatic display) with end‑to‑end ownership; or 5–7 years in analytical roles (e.g., finance/consulting) with strong media analytics exposure.

KPIs (directional; set as Rocks per client/Pod)

  • Growth: Increase qualified reach/new‑household acquisition; revenue and LTV contribution from TVAD; incremental reach vs. other media.

  • Quality:Better attention/viewability/brand safety; improved frequency/overlap control.

  • Product/AI adoption: Responsible, heavier use of Bliss Point and platform optimization with proven, incremental impact.

description: The Solar Technician III is a seasoned technician/professional that demonstrates a strong working knowledge of both AC/DC electrical and Data Acquisition/Monitoring systems on distributed generation scale solar photovoltaic (PV) power plants.

raw.title: Solar Technician III
raw.excerpt: The Solar Technician III is a seasoned technician/professional that demonstrates a strong working knowledge of both AC/DC electrical and Data Acquisition/Monitoring systems on distributed generation scale solar photovoltaic (PV) power plants.
raw.description:
The Solar Technician III is a seasoned technician/professional that demonstrates a strong working knowledge of both AC/DC electrical and Data Acquisition/Monitoring systems on distributed generation scale solar photovoltaic (PV) power plants. They will be responsible for corrective maintenance and operation of assigned solar projects to ensure optimal generation performance of the company’s solar photovoltaic (PV) plant portfolio. Overall responsibilities will include routine maintenance on solar equipment, providing oversight for complex work, assisting with technical project scope creation, and maintaining records of completed tasks and equipment status. Troubleshoot solar equipment safely with minimal help and supervision.

The Solar Tech III will work closely with the Operations/Asset Management teams to safely achieve overall Solar performance goals. This position will be remote and will cover projects throughout MA, CT, RI, with occasional support in northern NY.

Responsibilities Overview

  • The Solar Technician III is responsible for troubleshooting and repairing all equipment associated with solar facilities up to the medium voltage equipment.
  • Work safely under all circumstances, seek guidance regarding unfamiliar work to ensure safety and understanding of tasks to be performed
  • Manage work order system to ensure assign sites meet or exceed the weather adjusted performance targets, monitor assigned sites.
  • Keep track of work performed and update work orders.
  • Perform “status” checks including clearing “error” codes on solar equipment, make necessary repairs under supervision.
  • Respond “on-call” as directed by supervisor to assist in emergency equipment repairs
  • Performs/assists with technical and administrative duties associated with operating and maintaining a solar portfolio.
  • Attention to detail and safety focused
  • Perform advanced level troubleshooting for component repair and replacements with proficient use of specialized tools and diagnostic processes
  • Perform QA/QC inspections in accordance with applicable SOP
  • Assist Project managers and Asset managers with technical scope creation and root cause analysis
  • Safely measure DC and AC voltage and current utilizing a multimeter meter.
  • Replace or repair solar parts and/or equipment with no supervision
  • Understand electrical, mechanical, and hydraulic functions of all components of solar site and associated equipment.
  • Ensures work is performed in accordance with Environmental and Safety requirements.
  • May perform work independently and/or in work crews, depending upon skills and experience.
  • Maintain company tooling, facilities and equipment and a clean safe work environment
  • Identify electrical, environmental, and safety hazards associated with photovoltaic (PV) installations.
  • Become part of the team and prepared to learn new tasks.
  • Perform additional duties as required
  • Overnight travel as needed
  • Conduct maintenance of equipment (fueling, lubrication, etc.)
  • Lift and move equipment as needed (up to 50 pounds)
  • Responsible for the operation and maintenance of solar power plants in accordance with established standards and procedures; always maintains safety and professionalism
  • Provide a working knowledge of troubleshooting electrical components with help and use of digital multi-meters, meggers, amp clamps, and similar equipment. Tests installed equipment, ensuring proper working order including daily mechanical electrical inspections

Basic Qualifications

  • Knowledgeable technician/professional with four or more years of experience with solar photovoltaic (PV) power plant experience.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of SCADA, DAS and communication networks, protocols, and software.
  • Demonstrate commitment and participation in developing an accident-free work environment
  • Effective communication skills both written and verbal
  • Technical understanding of solar generation and energy storage
  • In field / hands on experience in solar construction and operation
  • Experience with electrical systems and familiarity of basic safety principles to include LOTO, Arc Flash and Electrical Safety.
  • Knowledge of AC/DC electrical systems and tools
  • Proven ability to work well within a multi-disciplinary team
  • Must be able to work outdoors in inclement weather
  • Ability to understand directions, follow procedures, and complete tasks with minimal oversight
  • Valid driver’s license and acceptable driving record.
  • Remain current in all safety and technical trainings
  • Knowledge of applicable safety and environmental regulations
  • Knowledge of electrical testing and equipment used at solar facilities including but not limited to; IR equipment and IV curve tracing.
  • Working knowledge of Solectria, SMA, Satcon, Advanced Energy/PVP central inverters
  • Working knowledge of Also Energy, Power Factors, MOXA, and SEEDS DAS equipment
  • Working knowledge of SEL protective devices
  • Working knowledge of MV Transformers and Switchgear

Preferred Qualifications

  • NABCEP PV Installer or Commissioning & Maintenance Specialist
  • OSHA – 30 Hour Certificate Holder
  • NFPA 70E Certificate Holder
  • AAS degree in electrical technology or equivalent
  • State Electrical license or training certificate

O que buscamos?

Buscamos um profissional de Site Reliability Engineering com forte especialização em Observabilidade, capaz de atuar de forma transversal entre diferentes áreas de tecnologia para mapear, compreender e monitorar a cadeia completa dos serviços e sistemas da organização.

O principal desafio desta posição será construir uma visão ponta a ponta dos serviços, identificando como aplicações, integrações, APIs, bancos de dados, componentes de infraestrutura, redes, mensageria e serviços de terceiros se relacionam para entregar cada serviço de negócio.

Forte capacidade de investigação técnica e visão sistêmica, que tenha facilidade para conversar com especialistas de diferentes disciplinas e transformar informações fragmentadas em uma visão integrada do ambiente.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Atuar junto aos times de Infraestrutura, Redes, Banco de Dados, Cloud, Segurança, Desenvolvimento, Arquitetura, Integração, Middleware, APIs e Sistemas, conduzindo levantamentos técnicos e workshops de descoberta.
  • Mapear a arquitetura e a cadeia de dependências dos principais sistemas da empresa, identificando todos os componentes envolvidos na entrega de cada serviço.
  • Construir o Service Mapping ponta a ponta, contemplando infraestrutura, aplicações, integrações, APIs, bancos de dados, filas, serviços externos e demais dependências.
  • Identificar os diferentes caminhos utilizados pelas integrações entre sistemas e compreender como cada componente impacta a disponibilidade do serviço.
  • Relacionar componentes técnicos com os respectivos serviços de negócio, permitindo maior entendimento do impacto de falhas.
  • Identificar lacunas de monitoração e observabilidade existentes nos ambientes.
  • Definir e implementar uma estratégia de observabilidade para os serviços mapeados, contemplando métricas, logs, traces, eventos, experiência digital e disponibilidade.
  • Criar monitoração orientada a serviço, deixando de observar apenas componentes isolados e passando a acompanhar o fluxo completo das transações e integrações.
  • Definir indicadores de confiabilidade como SLI, SLO e disponibilidade de serviços.
  • Construir dashboards, alertas, correlações e mecanismos de diagnóstico que permitam identificar rapidamente onde ocorreu uma degradação ou interrupção.
  • Trabalhar na redução de MTTD e MTTR, utilizando observabilidade para acelerar a identificação da causa raiz.
  • Participar de projetos corporativos desde suas fases iniciais, garantindo que novos sistemas e integrações já nasçam com requisitos adequados de observabilidade.
  • Apoiar a evolução da cultura de observabilidade dentro da organização, promovendo boas práticas entre os diferentes times técnicos.

  • Redes e protocolos de comunicação

  • Microserviços

  • Cloud e ambientes híbridos

  • Balanceadores, proxies e gateways
  • DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/IP e TLS
  • APM e Distributed Tracing
  • Centralização e análise de logs
  • Métricas e monitoramento de infraestrutura

  • SLI, SLO, SLA e Error Budget
  • Incident Management e análise de causa raiz

Ferramentas e tecnologias
