Alation is pioneering the next era of data intelligence — powered by AI agents and trusted data. Organizations around the world rely on Alation to drive self-service analytics, cloud transformation, data governance, and AI innovation. Our technology helps enterprises connect people and data to make faster, smarter, and more confident decisions. With more than $340M in funding – valued at over $1.7 billion and more than 650 customers, including 40% of the Fortune 100.

As data becomes the foundation of every business, Alation is leading the way in helping organizations unlock their full potential. By bringing intelligence, automation, and trust to every interaction, we empower customers to scale data-driven innovation with confidence and speed.

Joining Alation means being part of a winning team shaping the future of AI-powered data intelligence. We move fast, think big, and deliver results together.

Job Description:

Drive high-impact deployments at the intersection of data intelligence, AI, and governance, with deep grounding in the regulatory and operational realities of complex, regulated industries. As a Deployment Strategist, you act as a trusted advisor to enterprise stakeholders, translating complex governance and business challenges into a clear path toward measurable Alation adoption and value.

You bring expertise in the data space — data governance, data catalog, and/or governed AI concepts — along with knowledge of the broader data ecosystem. Strong industry acumen across target verticals (Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, and/or Hospitality and Travel) is essential, with the ability to speak to the governance, compliance, and data quality challenges specific to each.

What You’ll Do

  • Diagnose data and AI governance gaps specific to regulated, high-complexity industries and translate them into Alation-backed solutions.

  • Serve as a credible advisor on industry-specific governance frameworks (e.g., model risk management, data lineage requirements, regulatory reporting) as they relate to Alation's platform.

  • Help surface opportunities to expand product usage/consumption as a natural outcome of demonstrated value.

  • Lead discovery sessions to surface business and governance challenges.

  • Run product demonstrations and adoption workshops tailored to enterprise stakeholders.

  • Build a defensible, data-backed value story that connects governance outcomes to measurable business impact, giving customers clarity on the value Alation delivers.

  • Own end-to-end delivery of Alation implementations and services engagements,from kickoff through defined business outcomes.

  • Define KPIs and value measures; help customers articulate how Alation contributes to their governance and strategic goals.

  • Run enablement and adoption activities so governance practices are embedded into customer workflows, not just configured — helping customers govern their AI initiatives with the same rigor as their data.

  • Contribute to Executive Business Reviews, presenting governance and business outcomes with supporting data.

  • Partner with account teams to identify expansion opportunities emerging from your work.

What You Bring

  • Minimum 6+ years of consulting experience in a lead role with a proven track record of delivering successful projects that achieve measurable business outcomes by effectively addressing complex data management requirements, often within budget and with a focus on urgency.

  • Experience delivering services as part of a software company, understanding the dynamics of product implementation and customer success in the context of driving business results through technology.

  • Extensive data management experience with a focus on how data governance, data quality, master data management, and/or reference data directly enable business capabilities and contribute to achieving strategic objectives.

  • Demonstrated expertise in at least one target industry (Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, and/or Hospitality and Travel) and its governance/regulatory landscape.

  • Working understanding of data governance and AI governance concepts, metadata management, and how they map to platform capabilities. Hands-on configuration/build experience is a plus, not a requirement.

  • Energized and excited about thriving in a high-growth, startup environment where urgency and impact are valued, particularly in delivering data management solutions that drive business outcomes.

  • Passionately curious and committed to continuous learning and proactively innovating and improving both personally and professionally, staying ahead of industry trends and Alation capabilities to better advise customers on achieving business results through data management.

  • Comfortable and effective working in a non-traditional office environment using virtual teaming and working remotely, demonstrating strong collaboration skills regardless of location to partner effectively with customers on their journey from data requirements to business outcomes.

  • Deeply passionate about ensuring customers achieve maximum value out of their investment, acting as their advocate and partner in translating their data management needs into tangible business success.

  • Travel: ~15–30% for customer and prospect onsite visits.

title: Geospatial Analyst
description: Are you excited by the idea of using geospatial data to help restore habitats, protect wildlife, and tackle climate change?

raw.title: Geospatial Analyst
raw.excerpt: Are you excited by the idea of using geospatial data to help restore habitats, protect wildlife, and tackle climate change?
raw.description:
Are you excited by the idea of using geospatial data to help restore habitats, protect wildlife, and tackle climate change? So are we. At Oxygen Conservation, geospatial data isn’t background infrastructure – it shapes everything we do, one acquisition, one Biodiversity Net Gain project and one data collection app at a time. As we scale, we’re creating a new Geospatial Analyst role to power the mapping and data work behind our Natural Capital projects, our acquisitions pipeline, and our own internal software products. You’ll learn directly from Lara Salam, our GIS and Data Visualisation Lead, who’s built our entire GIS function from scratch, and grow your career at the pace we’re growing ours.

About You

We're looking for someone who’s eager to learn, grow, and take their technical skills and career to the next level – with a strong analytical mindset, a genuine curiosity about data, and an appetite for using AI to work smarter. Ideally, you’ll bring the following:

Environment

  • Passionate Explorer: Fuelled by a genuine passion for environmental conservation and making a tangible impact on the landscapes we protect.

  • Spatial Data Practitioner: Hands-on experience analysing, visualising, and managing spatial datasets, ideally within the ArcGIS Platform.

Impact

  • Data-Driven: Sharp attention to detail and a high standard for data quality in everything you touch.

  • Clear Communicator: Able to turn complex data into clear insights and visualisations, whether it’s a beautiful map, an informative dashboard, or a well-structured dataset.

Adventure

  • AI-Enabled Experimenter: Genuinely interested in using AI tools (think Claude Code) to write Python, automate workflows, and speed up your own work. No computer science background required, just curiosity and a willingness to have a go.

  • Practical Problem Solver: When the obvious approach doesn’t work, you try another, and another. You think outside the box rather than getting stuck.

Together

  • Commitment to Growth: A passion for lifelong learning and continuous personal development, growing alongside a team that invests in you.

  • Kindness and Approachability: And of course, you have to be really kind! Sharing snacks on long journeys or a packed lunch whilst out in the rain is mandatory!

We’re imagining this role for someone early in their GIS career, whether you’re finishing education, changing direction, or taking another route into the field. With direct coaching from Lara, we’ll support your growth and development. We believe in recruiting exceptional people and building a genuinely diverse team from across the country, with a broad range of lived and learned experiences. So, if you have some or all of the skills above, are full of enthusiasm, passionate about learning, and ready to work hard to Scale Conservation, apply now!

About the Role

As our Geospatial Analyst, you’ll be the engine room behind our Natural Capital projects and our growing suite of internal GIS tools. As Lara leads our geospatial strategy and internal software products, you’ll deliver hands-on GIS work that keeps our projects moving forward, with her coaching and mentoring you every step of the way. Once in the role, you’ll be joining a small, high-performing team that genuinely cares about you and your growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Natural Capital Mapping: Build and maintain the mapping and data behind our Biodiversity Net Gain, biodiversity credit and other Natural Capital projects, from baseline surveys through to vision maps, ready for planning and delivery.

  • New Frontiers: Get stuck into new areas of Natural Capital as we expand (think soil carbon and beyond), finding and building the datasets and maps that these emerging project types need.

  • Acquisitions Support: Source, prepare and quality-check the spatial data behind our acquisitions, from estate-level detail to country and regional-level searches, and help us automate more of this workflow through our internal tools.

  • Tools, Automation & Data Curation: Support the maintenance of our ArcGIS web and mobile apps, StoryMaps and dashboards, help streamline the manual and repetitive parts of our GIS workflows, and turn messy external data into clean, styled, ready-to-use datasets.

About us

Oxygen Conservation was founded in 2021 with a clear mission: Scaling Conservation. We're building the UK's first genuine natural capital portfolio, acquiring large landscapes, restoring them at scale, and creating investable natural capital products including premium carbon credits, biodiversity net gain units, renewable energy partnerships, and ecotourism experiences.

In just four years, we've grown to a valuation of around £400m, with 50,000+ acres owned and over half a million acres connected for nature. By 2030, we aim to have £1 billion of natural capital assets under management, enabling us to protect and restore 250,000 acres of land for people and wildlife.

Oxygen Capital is the investment and finance division of Oxygen Conservation, focused on raising capital, developing natural capital opportunities, and supporting the commercial growth of large-scale conservation. Oxygen Intelligence is our data and analytical infrastructure division, providing the insight, measurement, and proprietary tools that underpin our wider platform. While each division has a distinct external focus, all teams sit within the wider Oxygen Conservation platform and work closely together to deliver our mission of scaling conservation.

We move fast, hold ourselves to high standards, and genuinely believe that what we're building matters. If that sounds like the kind of place you do your best work, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Information

Term: Full-time, permanent.

Location: Remote (some travel to estates or other meetings expected).

Salary: £28,000

Closing date: 21st August

How to Apply: Visit our website and share your GIS work or a portfolio you’re proud of to support your application.

*This role is open to remote based candidates based in Canada with a preference for PST (hybrid) / EST (remote)*

We're looking for a Front End Developer to join our team as we enter our next stage of growth. You'll play a central role in how we craft the best-in-class user interfaces and experiences behind our SaaS products, building fast, accessible, and polished UX on our modern, cloud-native stack. You'll work on developing the components, patterns, and tools that help our teams deliver high quality experiences efficiently and consistently. This role is about tackling challenging front-end problems, caring about the details users feel, and applying best practices in modern front-end development to deliver pixel perfect UI.

Who we are

At Traction Rec, community is at the heart of everything we do. We empower nonprofit organizations like YMCAs, Jewish Community Centers (JCCs), Boys & Girls Clubs of America (BGCA), and Salvation Army Kroc Centers to strengthen their communities through great technology built on the Salesforce platform. By enabling these organizations to deliver their services more efficiently, we help them focus on creating meaningful connections and driving positive change where it matters most.

We believe that business is a powerful force for good. As part of this belief, we’ve committed to the Pledge 1% for the Planet, dedicating 1% of our time, product, profit, or equity to supporting environmental and community causes. This commitment reflects our dedication to creating a positive impact that extends beyond technology.

Our passion for community and innovation has earned us recognition, including:

  • Salesforce Nonprofit Sales Partner of the Year and ISV Partner of the Year
  • Globe & Mail's Top Growing Companies of 2024 and 2025
  • Deloitte's Technology Fast 50 winner 2024
  • Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 winner 2024 and 2025

At Traction Rec, we live our values: Community, Authenticity, Impact, Fun, and Growth. As a Living Wage Certified employer in British Columbia, we are dedicated to supporting not just the communities we serve but also the people who make it all happen—our team.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to join a company that puts community first, we’d love to have you on this journey with us. Together, let’s create stronger, healthier, and more connected communities.

Skills

Traction Rec’rs come from a variety of backgrounds, and we are eager to find people that are from diverse backgrounds. For this role, you might have:

  • Computer Science Degree or equivalent experience
  • 2 years+ professional experience building and shipping front-end applications
  • Strong understanding of component based JavaScript and TypeScript frameworks such as React, including component architecture
  • Understanding of fundamental design principles behind scalable applications
  • Solid grasp of state management (component, global, and visual state)
  • Excellent communication skills and experience working in a highly collaborative development team
  • Fluency with modern CSS and its different approaches
  • Understanding of accessibility, semantic HTML and WCAG compliance
  • Highly motivated with the ability to work and make decisions independently
  • Experience with trunk based development and continuous delivery in cloud environments like AWS and Vercel a plus
  • Bonus points if you've automated processes with AI and used AI coding agents in your workflow to ship high quality UI built by AI

Salesforce ISV experience not required - if you have strong fundamental product developer experience in other industries, and would be eager to lean into something new, we’ll be happy to teach you the platform specifics.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code across our cloud-native stack and Salesforce
  • Oversee proposed solutions to problems and ensure the implemented software will meet business objectives well into the future
  • Translate designs into polished, reusable UI and contribute to our shared component library
  • Own front-end quality: performance, accessibility, and cross-browser consistency
  • Identify bottlenecks and bugs, and devise solutions to these problems
  • Help maintain code quality, organization, and automatization
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues as part of tier 3 support
  • Design and ship new features across our existing and emerging products
  • Participate in monthly “spike days” where we all pair up and build whatever we want

Compensation

At Traction Rec, we are committed to a fair, market-based and equitable compensation structure. Our market data is refreshed on an annual basis to reflect the most current market conditions.

The starting salary band for this role is $80,000-$95,000. Starting salaries will vary within this range based on experience, skill level, and internal equity related to the role.

Please note that the range details above reflect the base pay only and does not include our competitive bonus program and benefits that we offer.

Our Approach to AI

At Traction Rec, we’re big fans of AI and we embrace it as a tool that helps us work smarter and more creatively. It may even have helped with this job description. That said, our recruiting process is 100% human. From resume review to interviews to job offers, every step is led by real people who care about real people. No bots making hiring decisions here.

If you’re interested, so are we! Send your resume our way, and let’s chat.

At Traction Rec, we believe that diversity and inclusion are essential to our success. We are committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve, and we actively seek and welcome candidates from all backgrounds. Our hiring process is designed to be fair, welcoming, and respectful to all candidates, regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, ability, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe that diversity brings unique perspectives and experiences that can enhance our team and drive innovation, and we are committed to providing equal opportunity and support to all candidates. We encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to the interview process and join us in building a diverse and inclusive culture at Traction Rec.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and marginalized groups are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Please note that employment is contingent on the successful completion of background and reference checks.

Our philosophy of continuous quality improvement (CQI) techniques in conjunction with our statistical process control methodology allows us to ensure a high degree of consistency in our approach to medical claim auditing. Efficient planning and maximized use of our proprietary systems and technology produces a streamlined audit product requiring fewer hours than competitors to complete.

This internship offers an excellent opportunity for students or early-career professionals interested in healthcare claims, insurance, data analysis, and auditing. The position is remote and approximately 20 hours per week, with flexible scheduling.

Position Summary:

The Specific Stop Loss Claim Auditor Intern will support the Audit Team by reviewing medical claim documentation, analyzing data, and assisting with stop loss claim audits. The intern will gain hands-on experience with healthcare claims administration, reimbursement methodologies, and audit processes while working alongside experienced professionals in the industry.

  • Assist with reviewing and auditing specific stop loss claim submissions.

  • Analyze medical and pharmaceutical claims data.

  • Utilize Excel and other Microsoft Office applications to organize, analyze, and report data.

  • Support auditors in preparing client reports and audit summaries.

  • Participate in process improvement initiatives and special projects.

  • Maintain confidentiality of protected health information (PHI) and sensitive client data.

  • Communicate effectively with team members regarding audit findings and project status.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Currently a sophomore in college pursuing a degree in Healthcare or a Science related field.

  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.

  • High attention to detail and strong organizational skills.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks in a remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Coursework or internship experience related to healthcare, insurance, auditing, or claims administration.

  • Familiarity with healthcare claims processing or medical billing concepts.

  • Experience using Excel features such as formulas, sorting, filtering, and pivot tables.

  • Exposure to healthcare reimbursement methodologies, including Medicare, DRG, or RBRVS.

  • Experience with Microsoft Access or other database applications.

$19.00 - $19.00 Hourly

Job Description:

Parsons is seeking a talented Integrated Master Scheduler to join our growing team!

In this role you will be joining a small, fast-moving program team supporting a classified space portfolio. You will be responsible for building, maintaining, and analyzing an Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) across multiple projects, ensuring schedule integrity, resource alignment, and program fidelity to key milestones. This role requires a detail-oriented critical thinker and self-starter who can pull in data from various data sets independently and make recommendations enabling program management decisions.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Develop, maintain, and status the program IMS in Microsoft Project, ensuring fully networked logic, dependencies, and alignment with program milestones.

  • Perform critical path analysis, resource loading, and schedule performance tracking.

  • Ensure integration of schedules across IPTs, suppliers, WBS elements, and subcontractors.

  • Apply resource loading to support realistic staffing plans and capacity assessments in coordination with program leads and business management.

  • Prepare and deliver schedule reports, metrics, and forecasts.

  • Support schedule risk assessments and “what-if” analyses to evaluate alternatives, quantify schedule risk, and inform risk mitigation strategies.

  • Maintain configuration control of the baseline schedule, documenting changes, rationales, and impacts.

  • Ensure schedule activities and logic reflect technical baselines, interfaces, and dependencies across space, ground, software, integration, and test activities.

  • Contribute to acquisition and program planning (e.g. IMS deliverables, CDRLs, proposal volumes, Integrated Master Plan, RFP responses, and task order proposals).

  • Contribute to preparation and review of acquisition documents, technical reviews, and schedule-related contract deliverables and proposals.

What Required Skills You'll Bring:

  • Active Top Secret clearance with the willingness and ability to obtain/maintain SCI

  • Bachelor’s degree, with additional years of experience able to count in lieu of a degree.

  • 20+ years of work experience, with additional education able to count towards total years of experience.

  • Demonstrated proficiency with Microsoft Project for building and maintaining fully networked schedules, including dependencies, constraints, and resource assignments.

  • Experience supporting Integrated Master Schedules for complex, multi-discipline programs with multiple IPTs and subcontractors.

  • Understanding of EVM principles.

  • Experience conducting critical path analysis and communicating schedule status, risks, and impacts to program stakeholders.

  • Project management principles

  • Ability to communicate technical and programmatic information clearly across diverse teams

What Desired Skills You'll Bring:

  • Prior experience supporting a space system program in a government or industry program office.

  • Familiarity with Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) tools and methods and ability to align schedule activities with system models and architectures.

  • Familiarity with systems engineering (requirements, design, integration, verification, validation) and their translation into schedule logic and milestones.

  • Experience with configuration management processes and tools, including maintaining traceability between the IMS, baselines, and program documentation.

  • Experience writing or contributing to acquisition and program documents (e.g. IMP, RFPs and proposals) for DoD or intelligence community customers.

Security Clearance Requirement:

An active Top Secret security clearance is required for this position.​This position is part of our Federal Solutions team.The Federal Solutions segment delivers resources to our US government customers that ensure the success of missions around the globe. We promote a culture of excellence and close-knit teams that take pride in delivering, protecting, and sustaining our nation's most critical assets, from Earth to cyberspace. Throughout the company, our people are anticipating what’s next to deliver the solutions our customers need now.Salary Range: $134,100.00 - $241,400.00We value our employees and want our employees to take care of their overall wellbeing, which is why we offer best-in-class benefits such as medical, dental, vision, paid time off, Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), 401(k), life insurance, flexible work schedules, and holidays to fit your busy lifestyle!This position will be posted for a minimum of 3 days and will continue to be posted for an average of 30 days until a qualified applicant is selected or the position has been cancelled.Parsons is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other protected status.We truly invest and care about our employee’s wellbeing and provide endless growth opportunities as the sky is the limit, so aim for the stars! AML Compliance Officer - Belgium (Work From Home)

As an AML Compliance Officer, you will support Western Union Agents' efforts in implementing Anti-Money Laundering, Counter Terrorist Financing, and Anti-Fraud policies and procedures. Also, you will evaluate how Western Union Agents incorporate compliance requirements and standards through conducting activity analysis, compliance reviews, and training sessions. If required, you will follow up with Agents to ensure compliance program gaps are eliminated and identified findings are remediated.

Role Responsibilities

  • Performing onsite and/or offsite AML/CTF/Anti-Fraud Compliance program reviews of new, and existing Agents of Western Union, and its affiliates.
  • Providing support and training to Western Union Agents to implement an effective AML/CTF and anti-fraud Compliance program.
  • Evaluating controls both internally and with our agent partners through analysis and supporting them in delivering compliance programs.
  • Escalating compliance-related risk matters diligently and in a timely manner.
  • Assisting your team in the overall development of AML programs, especially related to end-to-end process tasks and initiatives.
  • Assisting department management with project-related activities and/or additional tasks based on business needs.
  • Implementing policies and procedures and working closely with the global agent oversight and regional compliance teams which will help you achieve consistency.
  • Submitting daily reports to the government portal.

Role Requirements

  • You will have relevant experience within the AML or Compliance field.
  • Fluency in English and French
  • Dutch languages preferable
  • In addition, we require you to have experience communicating with clients/customers (preferably face-to-face and/or via phone) and the ability to manage challenging situations.
  • Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to understand laws and regulations related to AML/CTF and Anti-Fraud policies and procedures.
  • Traveling flexibility up to 50%, adjusted based on business needs.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills (oral and written).
  • Ability to work independently and have strong time management skills.
  • Proficiency with all common Office programs such as: MS Excel, Word, Outlook (but not limited to). Understanding of appropriate regional and global Money Services Business (MSB) regulatory requirements, the Bank Secrecy Act, and their effect on our business will make you stand out.

Work Shifts

Western Union values in-person collaboration, problem solving, and ideation whenever possible. We believe this fosters common ways of working and supports how we execute initiatives for our customers. However, due to the nature of this role, there is no specific office location where the employee is expected to report. The employee must align with their manager on other expected in-person collaboration opportunities.

  • Pension Plan
  • Luncheon Vouchers

Applicants will need to provide their name andemail addressinorder toprocess the assessments.If you have any questions, you may reach out .

raw.description:
Automation & AI Developer (Remote)

Location: Remote
Type: Full-time (40 hrs/week)
Hours: Must overlap with US Pacific Time

Role Overview

We are hiring an Automation & AI Developer to design and build AI-powered systems that improve business operations.

This role combines technical execution with strategic thinking. You will assess workflows, identify automation opportunities, and build scalable solutions using AI tools and automation platforms. You'll also create clear documentation and enable non-technical teams to operate systems independently.

This is a client-facing role requiring both strong technical ability and the ability to communicate solutions clearly.

Key Responsibilities

AI Strategy & Solution Design

  • Analyze business operations and identify automation opportunities
  • Define clear automation hypotheses and expected outcomes
  • Design scalable AI and automation architectures
  • Present recommendations to stakeholders

Automation Development

  • Build end-to-end automations using tools like Zapier or Make
  • Integrate AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude) into workflows
  • Test, deploy, and optimize automation systems
  • Create reusable templates and systems

Systems & Infrastructure

  • Manage and maintain WordPress environments
  • Handle hosting, domains, and basic server administration
  • Support integrations across tools and platforms
  • Monitor system performance and proactively resolve issues

Documentation & Enablement

  • Write clear, step-by-step documentation for non-technical users
  • Train team members on using and maintaining systems
  • Contribute to internal knowledge base and best practices

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field﻿
  • Background in software development or system architecture
  • Hands-on experience with automation tools (Zapier and/or Make)
  • Experience using AI tools in development workflows (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.)
  • Strong understanding of LLM capabilities and limitations
  • Experience with GitHub (version control, repositories)
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure / virtual servers
  • WordPress development or administration experience
  • Strong written English and documentation skills
  • Ability to work with US Pacific Time overlap

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Python or similar scripting language
  • Familiarity with tools like GoHighLevel, Mindbody, or Acuity
  • Experience in client-facing or consulting environments
  • Experience assessing systems and recommending automation solutions

What We're Looking For

  • Strong problem-solver who thinks in systems, not tasks
  • Able to balance strategy and execution
  • Clear communicator who can explain technical concepts simply
  • Proactive and comfortable working independently
  • Practical mindset — tests ideas before scaling

Success in This Role

  • Deliver working automation systems that improve real workflows
  • Create documentation that enables non-technical users
  • Build scalable, reliable solutions
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of internal systems

As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.



About the Role:
We’re looking for people with limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to the customer to join us in shaping the future of cybersecurity. Consistently recognised as a top workplace, CrowdStrike is committed to cultivating an inclusive, remote-first culture that offers people the autonomy and flexibility to balance the needs of work and life while taking their career to the next level. Interested in working for a company that sets the standard and leads with integrity? Join us on a mission that matters - one team, one fight

What You'll Do:

  • Serves as customer liaison with internal CrowdStrike stakeholders to ensure needed customer feedback is adequately documented and assessed by internal parties.

  • Resolves customer problems via telephone, email, chat or remote access.

  • Research customers’ technical issues in a timely manner and follow up with recommendations and action plans.

  • Escalates cases to management when customer satisfaction comes into question.

  • Participates in functional groups to identify and drive resolution for escalated cases.

  • Contribute and utilize internal technical expertise, including development engineers, knowledge base, and other internal tools to provide the most effective solutions to customer issues.

  • Create knowledge base content and systems to capture new learning for reuse throughout the company and user base.

  • Lead technical communications within the team to share best practices and knowledge.

  • Provide well-thought out and reliable direction, both in technical and non-technical terms, to help customers integrate, deploy and maintain the CrowdStrike service.

  • Take end-to-end ownership of customer issues, including initial troubleshooting, identification of root cause and issue resolution.

  • Exceeds customer expectations on response quality, timeliness of responses and overall customer experience.

  • Serve as an internal point of contact on customer escalations and ensure customer issues are resolved as expediently as possible.

  • Collect information and document bugs with Engineering for product issues that are impacting customers.

  • Pushes creative thinking beyond the boundaries of existing industry standard practices to come up with process improvements to delight customers.

  • Subject Matter Expert on one key product feature.

What You'll Need:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent

  • 2+ years of customer support, technical support, system administration or related customer facing role.

  • Demonstrable skills in supporting and deploying cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP) and associated certifications.

  • Expertise in managing and troubleshooting Kubernetes & Containers

  • Technical expertise on Linux platforms

  • Passion for solving customer issues and advocating for their success, in a fast paced, highly technical environment.

  • Ability to learn new technologies quickly.

  • Excellent relationship management, customer service and communication skills in a variety of forms (written, live chat, conference calls, in-person.)

  • Ability to work independently with little direct supervision and as a part of a team.

  • Outstanding analytical and organizational abilities.

  • Ability to remain calm, composed and articulate when dealing with tough customer situations.

  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with Linux

  • Experience with supporting and troubleshooting API

  • Experience supporting Kernel level security solutions

  • Experience supporting hybrid environments

  • Experience supporting security applications such as AV, VPN, Firewall, proxy.

  • Experience with Splunk

  • Certification in relevant technologies or platforms (AWS Certified Developer, Google Cloud Certified - Professional Cloud Developer)


Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:

  • Market leader in compensation and equity awards
  • Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs
  • Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge
  • Paid parental and adoption leaves
  • Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role
  • Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections
  • Vibrant office culture with world class amenities
  • Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe

CrowdStrike is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a culture of belonging where everyone is valued for who they are and empowered to succeed. We support veterans and individuals with disabilities through our affirmative action program.


CrowdStrike is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants for employment. The Company does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, creed, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy or pregnancy-related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, marital or family status, veteran status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, membership or activity in a local human rights commission, status with regard to public assistance, or any other characteristic protected by law. We base all employment decisions--including recruitment, selection, training, compensation, benefits, discipline, promotions, transfers, lay-offs, return from lay-off, terminations and social/recreational programs--on valid job requirements.


If you need assistance accessing or reviewing the information on this website or need help submitting an application for employment or requesting an accommodation, please contact us at for further assistance.

This is your opportunity to join Inizio Engage and support a top biotechnology company advancing care for patients living with migraine.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage; accrued paid time off; 401(k) with company match; disability and life insurance; and paid maternity and paternity leave

We’re also proud to be recognized for creating an exceptional employee experience:

Learn more:

raw.title: Director, Software Engineering
raw.excerpt: About UsAt Cast & Crew, we’ve empowered creativity and supported the global entertainment industry for decades.
raw.description:
About Us

At Cast & Crew, we’ve empowered creativity and supported the global entertainment industry for decades. Together with our family of brands - Backstage, CAPS, Checks & Balances, Final Draft, Media Services, Sargent-Disc, and The TEAM Companies – we operate as a combined entertainment technology and services provider offering industry standard screenwriting accounting software, digital payroll products, data & reporting, and a host of creative tools. The industry continues to move faster than ever, and the need for our expertise, our technology, and our people has never been greater. We are a production’s best ally every step of the way. #OneCastOneCrew

Position Overview

We're looking for a Director of Software Engineering to lead multiple engineering teams within our Onboarding and Timekeeping product line — one of the most active and strategically important areas of the business. This is a role for a leader, not just a manager. You'll cultivate ownership and decision-making at the team level, develop strong engineering anchors, and create an environment where your teams don't wait for direction — they are empowered to move.

You'll own the engineering execution of a robust product roadmap that includes mobile applications in a rapid growth phase, drive deep collaboration with Product and QA, and connect your teams into the broader engineering organization through a Spotify-inspired model of Squads, Tribes, Chapters, and Guilds. You'll also champion our initiative to embed AI meaningfully into how we build software.

We're in the middle of a cultural shift — moving faster, owning outcomes, celebrating wins, and holding each other to a high bar. We work hard and play hard. This role requires someone who can get up to speed quickly, lead with empathy from day one, and immediately begin delivering impact.

Core Responsibilities

Servant Leadership & Team Development

  • Build a culture of distributed ownership — push decision-making down to the team level and develop strong team anchors who lead with confidence

  • Coach and grow engineering managers, QA leads, and senior engineers into well-rounded technical leaders

  • Embody the distinction between leadership and management: inspire, develop, and get out of the way

  • Champion a work hard, play hard team culture — high standards, fast feedback, and genuine celebration of wins

Spotify Model: Squads, Tribes, Chapters & Guilds

Our engineering organization is structured around the Spotify model, and this leader plays an active role in making it real — not just understanding it on paper.

  • Lead and align multiple Squads — autonomous, cross-functional teams each owning a slice of the Onboarding and Timekeeping product line — ensuring they have the clarity, resources, and psychological safety to self-organize and deliver

  • Operate as a Tribe leader across these Squads, driving coherence, shared mission, and cross-team coordination within the product line

  • Actively develop Chapters — communities of engineers who share a discipline (e.g., mobile, backend, QA) — ensuring members grow in craft, adopt consistent practices, and carry excellence across Squad boundaries

  • Grow and support Guilds as voluntary communities of interest that spread knowledge and innovation across the broader engineering organization

  • Use this structure not as org-chart formality, but as the engine for building well-rounded, continuously improving team members

Mobile Applications & Rapid Growth

  • Guide engineering strategy and execution for mobile applications that are in an active rapid growth phase — balancing speed, quality, and scalability

  • Partner with mobile chapter leads and senior engineers to establish strong mobile engineering practices, CI/CD pipelines, and quality standards

  • Anticipate the unique challenges of scaling a mobile product: release cadence, device fragmentation, app store pipelines, and performance at scale

  • Attract and develop mobile engineering talent to match the growth trajectory of the product

Product Delivery & Quality

  • Own engineering delivery against a demanding roadmap — shorten delivery timelines, improve delivery quality, and build the practices that make both sustainable

  • Set clear commitments, surface risks early, and consistently ship with quality

  • Involve QA leads as first-class collaborators in planning, not an afterthought at the end

  • Work shoulder-to-shoulder with Product to refine priorities, scope tradeoffs, and translate business goals into engineering plans

Cross-Product Collaboration

  • Navigate a complex integration landscape — your teams touch and are touched by multiple other product lines; you ensure those relationships are healthy, proactive, and unblocking

  • Drive alignment and coordination across internal product teams and with peer engineering leaders in other product lines

  • Represent your teams well in cross-functional forums and escalate and resolve dependencies with urgency

AI-Driven SDLC

  • Own the strategy and execution of our AI-Driven SDLC initiative — define how AI tooling is adopted, measured, and continuously improved across your teams

  • Establish metrics that demonstrate real gains in velocity and quality, not just adoption theater

  • Stay ahead of the tooling landscape and bring informed, opinionated recommendations to the organization

Technical Direction

  • Maintain strong technical engagement — able to get into architecture decisions, unblock teams, and give meaningful feedback on system design and engineering quality

  • Partner with architects and senior engineers to ensure decisions align with long-term platform goals

  • Drive engineering quality through observability, incident response, code standards, and post-mortems

Key Qualifications

  • 10+ years in software engineering, with 4+ years in engineering leadership managing managers

  • Strong technical background — you can engage credibly on system design, architecture tradeoffs, and engineering quality

  • A proven philosophy of developing leaders, not just managing reports — you know the difference and live it

  • Experience leading or scaling mobile application engineering, ideally in a high-growth context

  • Track record of shortening delivery timelines and improving quality through process, culture, and tooling — not heroics

  • Hands-on familiarity with the Spotify model (Squads, Tribes, Chapters, Guilds) and experience operating within or building toward it

  • Experience leading globally distributed teams across multiple time zones

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration instincts — especially with Product and QA

  • Experience with AI-assisted development tooling and enthusiasm for applying it to improve team productivity

  • Excellent communicator; comfortable at the executive level and equally comfortable listening at the team level

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in workforce management, payroll, timekeeping, or HR tech domains

  • Experience managing teams with heavy external integration complexity

  • Familiarity with engineering metrics frameworks (DORA, SPACE, etc.)

  • Prior experience driving a meaningful cultural transformation

Special Work Conditions

  • Sedentary – Involves sitting most of the time but may involve walking or standing for brief periods of time. Some positions may entail exerting up to 15 lbs. of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force to lift, carry, push, or pull.

Benefits

Cast & Crew provides a comprehensive package of employee benefits including: Medical, Dental, Vision, PTO, health and wellness programs, employee discounts, and more! Note: Cast & Crew benefits are subject to eligibility requirements.

Cast & Crew is an equal opportunity employer committed to hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all individuals based on job-related qualifications and ability to perform a job, without regard to age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, creed, national origin, disability, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship or marital status, and to maintain a non-discriminatory environment free from intimidation, harassment or bias based upon these grounds.

CA residents
Your personal information may be collected in connection with certain services provided by Cast & Crew or its affiliated companies. A summary of your California privacy rights can be found at:

Compensation is commensurate with various factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, qualifications, skills, training, licensure, certifications, geographic cost of labor, and other business and organizational needs. Compensation range for candidates in other locations may differ based on the cost of labor in that location. The compensation range for this position is: $180,000.00 - $225,000.00 per year.

raw.title: Senior Sales Executive (Denver)
raw.excerpt: Why Pythian: At Pythian, we are experts in strategic database and analytics services, driving digital transformation and operational excellence.
raw.description:
Why Pythian:

At Pythian, we are experts in strategic database and analytics services, driving digital transformation and operational excellence. Pythian, a multinational company, was founded in 1997 and started by ensuring the reliability and performance of mission-critical databases. We quickly earned a reputation for solving tough data challenges. We were there when the industry moved from on-premises to cloud environments, and as enterprises sought more from their data, we expanded our competencies to include advanced analytics.

Today, we empower organizations to embrace transformation and leverage advanced technologies, including AI, to stay competitive. We deliver innovative solutions that meet each client’s data goals and have built strong partnerships with Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, and Snowflake. The powerful combination of our extensive expertise in data and cloud and our ability to keep on top of the latest bleeding edge technologies make us the perfect partner to help mid and large-sized businesses transform to stay ahead in today’s rapidly changing digital economy.

Why you:

Pythian sits at the intersection of data engineering, AI production, and managed services — helping enterprises turn data complexity into competitive advantage. With three decades of deep managed services heritage and strategic partnerships across the leading cloud and database technology ecosystems, we are at the forefront of helping clients move from AI experimentation to AI in production.

We are looking for a polished, quota-carrying Senior Sales Executive who is energized by the AI moment and knows how to help enterprise clients build the modern, well-managed data foundations that make production AI possible at scale. You are comfortable hunting new logos, converting inbound leads, and growing existing accounts. You bring credibility in conversations about Database Managed Services, Production AI, and cloud and database technologies — and you know how to co-sell effectively with OEM and hyperscaler partners to drive mutual value.

What Makes This Role Unique:

Pythian’s portfolio spans the full stack from data foundations to production AI — Production AI, Database Managed Services, AI Strategy & Automation, Data Migrations, Cloud Consulting, and Agentic AI solutions, supported by partnerships across Google Cloud, Oracle, AWS, Microsoft Azure, SAP, and the broader modern data ecosystem. This means you’re never selling a point solution; you’re building long-term, high-value partnerships with clients who want a trusted advisor to help them scale intelligently.

If you’re energized by the AI transformation happening across enterprise technology right now, know how to sell complex managed services, and want to represent a company with deep technical credibility and a growing AI practice — this role is built for you.

What you will be doing:

Territory & Pipeline

  • Build and execute a territory plan with a disciplined mix of new logo hunting, inbound conversion, and account expansion.
  • Maintain a robust, accurately forecasted pipeline in Salesforce; provide weekly pipeline reviews and revenue projections.
  • Develop targeted account strategies for key prospects in retail, manufacturing, logistics, financial services, and other enterprise verticals.
  • Identify and pursue net-new logos while deepening relationships and expanding wallet share within existing accounts.

AI & Data Services Sales

  • Lead discovery and solution conversations around Production AI, AI Strategy, Agentic AI, and AI Automation with enterprise buyers (CAIO, CDO, CTO, CIO).
  • Articulate how modern, well-managed data estates — across databases, cloud data platforms, and data migrations — are the critical scaffolding for scalable AI.
  • Sell the business case for Database Managed Services and DBA Support, connecting operational reliability to AI readiness and cost efficiency.
  • Help clients understand Pythian’s phased “Data Foundations to Production AI” journey and position appropriate entry points based on their maturity.

Partner & OEM Co-sell

  • Co-sell with hyperscaler and OEM field teams — including Google Cloud, Oracle — to drive joint pipeline and leverage partner co-sell programs, Marketplace motions, and funded assessment opportunities.
  • Navigate partner deal registration, funding programs, and co-sell qualification processes across multiple technology ecosystems to accelerate deal velocity and protect margin.
  • Build and maintain strong field relationships with partner account teams, knowing how to activate the right partner resources at the right stage of a deal.
  • Serve as the primary relationship owner for your accounts while leveraging Pythian’s delivery, solutions, and field CTO resources as needed.

Deal Execution & Internal Orchestration

  • Lead enterprise sales cycles end-to-end: discovery, business case development, proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Act as the internal project manager for your deals — coordinating across Solutions Architecture, Delivery, Legal, and Finance to keep complex cycles moving, ensure scope integrity, and deliver proposals on time.
  • Know when and how to engage the right internal resources (Field CTO, practice leads, delivery SMEs) and manage those relationships to build credibility with prospects without over-committing delivery capacity.
  • Prepare and present compelling proposals, RFP responses, and executive-level business case materials.
  • Document client interactions, capture competitive intelligence, and share win/loss insights to continuously improve Pythian’s go-to-market.

Travel as required to attend client meetings, partner events, industry conferences, and Pythian’s annual sales kickoff.

What we need from you:

  • 10+ years of enterprise technology sales experience with a consistent record of meeting or exceeding quota.
  • Active experience selling Data & AI services — managed databases, cloud data platforms, AI strategy, or production AI implementations — to enterprise buyers.
  • Demonstrated ability to sell managed services: you know who to call, how to build the business case, and how to navigate procurement for recurring-revenue engagements.
  • Experience co-selling with hyperscaler or OEM field teams (Google Cloud, Oracle, AWS, Microsoft, or similar), including familiarity with partner programs, deal registration, and funded motions.
  • Strong internal project management instincts: proven ability to orchestrate cross-functional resources — solutions architects, delivery leads, legal, finance — across complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles without losing momentum or scope control.
  • A hunter’s instinct for new logos combined with the relationship acumen to grow and retain existing accounts.
  • Polished enterprise presence with the ability to engage confidently at VP and C-suite level across business and technical audiences.
  • Proficiency in Salesforce for pipeline management, forecasting, and account planning.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience selling within one or more of Pythian’s core technology ecosystems: Google Cloud (BigQuery, Vertex AI, Gemini) and/or Oracle (database, infrastructure), and also AWS, Microsoft Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, or SAP.
  • Familiarity with the modern data stack and cloud data platforms across multiple hyperscalers.
  • Comfort positioning AI solutions — Agentic AI, GenAI/RAG, MLOps, AI automation — to enterprise decision-makers.
  • Experience with Database Managed Services or Infrastructure Managed Services sales cycles and pricing models.
  • Background selling into $300M–$1B revenue companies in manufacturing, retail, logistics, finance, or healthcare verticals.
  • Relevant cloud, database, or AI certifications are a plus.

Core Competencies

  • Strategic territory planning and disciplined pipeline management.
  • Consultative selling — ability to diagnose business problems before proposing solutions.
  • Influence, persuasion, and consensus-building across complex enterprise buying committees.
  • Continuous learning mindset — genuinely curious about AI developments and their enterprise implications.
  • Clear, compelling written and verbal communication; strong presentation and proposal skills.
  • Relevant Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of experience and education.

What you will receive:

  • Love your career: Competitive total rewards package. Blog during work hours; take a day off and volunteer for your favorite charity.
  • Love your work/life balance: Flexibly work remotely from your home, there’s no daily travel requirement to an office! All you need is a stable internet connection.
  • Love your coworkers: Collaborate with some of the best and brightest in the industry!
  • Love your development: Hone your skills or learn new ones with our substantial training allowance; participate in professional development days, attend training, become certified, whatever you like!
  • Love your workspace: We give you all the equipment you need to work from home including a laptop with your choice of OS, and an annual budget to personalize your work environment!
  • Love yourself: Pythian cares about the health and well-being of our team. You will have an annual wellness budget to make yourself a priority (use it on gym memberships, massages, fitness and more). Additionally, you will receive a generous amount of paid vacation and sick days, as well as a day off to volunteer for your favorite charity.

HiringDisclaimer

  • The successful applicant will need to fulfill the requirements necessary to obtain a background check.
  • Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in any aspect of the selection process.

AI Disclaimer

Pythian may utilize Enterprise Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools or features throughout its hiring process. These tools help us manage high volumes of applications efficiently and may be employed to review applications, analyze resumes, and assist with other recruitment steps. While Pythian uses AI in its hiring process, it does not substitute for human judgment. 26WD100492, Principal Data Analyst

Position Overview

Autodesk has invested in data-driven decision-making, optimizing our platform’s business, product, and cost. The next five years will transform how we work, with a surge in data volume and scaling of AI/ML to provide even greater value to our customers. We are looking for a Principal Data Analyst to serve as a senior individual contributor and trusted thought partner to Product, Engineering, Strategy, Research, and business leaders. You will define how success is measured, uncover high-value opportunities, lead rigorous experimentation, and build trusted analytical products and AI assisted workflows that turn complex data into better decisions at scale.

This role combines deep product analytics judgment, strong SQL/Python capability, software engineering discipline, and practical fluency with modern AI tools. You will operate comfortably in ambiguity, influence product direction, and create reusable systems that increase the leverage of teams across the organization.

If you are excited about empowering teams and influencing the organization with insights that drive success, this is the role for you!

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with product managers and cross-functional teams to identify, define, and address business problems and opportunities through data analysis

  • Use your analytical skills to derive actionable insights from large and complex datasets and communicate findings in a clear and concise manner to technical and non-technical audiences

  • Define product measurement across north-star metrics, KPI/OKR frameworks, metric trees, instrumentation, guardrails, and launch measurement for platform initiatives

  • Use AI coding and analysis tools to accelerate SQL/Python development, automate repeatable analytical work, prototype lightweight data applications or assistants, and create reusable workflows with appropriate validation, provenance, and human review

  • Create clear and impactful data visualizations using tools such as Power BI, Looker, or similar, to communicate findings and recommendations to stakeholders across the organization

  • Build and evolve canonical datasets, semantic models, metric definitions, dashboards, and self-service experiences that can be reliably consumed by both people and AI systems

  • Proactively mine for data drive insights to support PSET's platform outcomes, focusing on performance, user engagement, and overall business impact

  • Partner with Data Engineering on data quality, lineage, observability, and scalable pipelines; use version control, testing, code review, and reproducible development practices for high-value analytical assets

  • Communicate complex findings as concise decisions and trade-offs for technical and executive audiences; mentor analysts and cross-functional partners on problem framing, experimentation, AI-assisted analytics, and data storytelling

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in large data analysis, business intelligence, or a related field, preferably within a technology or SaaS environment

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field such as Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related discipline. Demonstrated principal/staff level scope: independently shaping ambiguous problems, influencing product roadmaps, and driving decisions across multiple teams

  • Hands on experience using AI assisted development and analysis tools (Claude Code, Cursor etc.) to accelerate coding, automate workflows, prototype tools, or extend beyond traditional analyst workflows

  • Strong skills in data querying and manipulation with SQL, and proficiency in programming languages like Python or R for data analysis and modeling. Experience with data warehouse ELT tools (Airflow, dbt, Snowflake)

  • Experience with semantic layers, governed metric definitions, and BI/visualization tools such as Looker or Power BI, with a track record of enabling trustworthy self-service analytics

  • Proven analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capability to work independently on complex datasets and derive actionable insights

  • Knowledge of statistical techniques and modeling methodologies to drive in-depth data insights and support predictive analytics

  • Strong ability to communicate complex data insights and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders in a clear and accessible manner

  • Effective team player with a strong ability to work across functions, engage with diverse stakeholders, and provide data-driven support for strategic initiatives

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience working in a SaaS company or a platform engineering organization is preferred

  • Familiarity with Autodesk’s product portfolio and its applications in various industries is an advantage

  • Experience analyzing AI/ML or agentic products, including evaluation frameworks and quality, task success, latency, reliability, or cost trade-offs

  • Experience building lightweight internal data products, analytical applications, or LLM enabled tools connected to governed enterprise data

  • Master’s degree in a quantitative field such as Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related discipline

26WD100492, Analyste principal des données

Aperçu du Poste

Autodesk s’est engagé dans une démarche de prise de décision fondée sur les données, visant à optimiser les activités, les produits et les coûts de notre plateforme. Les cinq prochaines années vont transformer notre façon de travailler, avec une explosion du volume de données et une généralisation de l’IA et du ML afin d’apporter encore plus de valeur à nos clients. Nous recherchons un analyste de données principal qui jouera le rôle de collaborateur senior et de partenaire de réflexion de confiance auprès des responsables des produits, de l’ingénierie, de la stratégie, de la recherche et des dirigeants de l’entreprise. Vous définirez les indicateurs de réussite, identifierez les opportunités à forte valeur ajoutée, mènerez des expérimentations rigoureuses et développerez des outils analytiques fiables ainsi que des flux de travail assistés par l’IA, capables de transformer des données complexes en meilleures décisions à grande échelle.

Ce poste allie un sens aigu de l’analyse produit, de solides compétences en SQL et Python, une rigueur en ingénierie logicielle et une maîtrise pratique des outils modernes d’IA. Vous serez à l’aise dans l’ambiguïté, influencerez l’orientation des produits et créerez des systèmes réutilisables qui renforceront l’efficacité des équipes à tous les niveaux de l’organisation.

Si vous êtes motivé(e) par l’idée de donner les moyens d’agir aux équipes et d’influencer l’organisation grâce à des informations qui favorisent la réussite, ce poste est fait pour vous !

Responsabilités

  • Collaborer avec les chefs de produit et les équipes transversales pour identifier, définir et traiter les problèmes et opportunités métier par le biais de l’analyse de données

  • Utiliser vos compétences analytiques pour tirer des enseignements exploitables à partir d’ensembles de données volumineux et complexes, et communiquer vos conclusions de manière claire et concise à un public technique et non technique

  • Définir les mesures de performance des produits à travers les indicateurs phares, les cadres KPI/OKR, les arborescences de métriques, l’instrumentation, les garde-fous et les mesures de lancement pour les initiatives de la plateforme

  • Utiliser des outils de codage et d’analyse basés sur l’IA pour accélérer le développement en SQL/Python, automatiser les tâches analytiques récurrentes, prototyper des applications ou des assistants de données légers, et créer des flux de travail réutilisables avec validation, traçabilité et révision humaine appropriées

  • Créer des visualisations de données claires et percutantes à l’aide d’outils tels que Power BI, Looker ou similaires, afin de communiquer les conclusions et les recommandations aux parties prenantes de toute l’organisation

  • Construire et faire évoluer des ensembles de données canoniques, des modèles sémantiques, des définitions de métriques, des tableaux de bord et des expériences en libre-service pouvant être exploités de manière fiable tant par les utilisateurs que par les systèmes d’IA

  • Exploiter de manière proactive les données pour en tirer des enseignements permettant de soutenir les résultats de la plateforme PSET, en mettant l’accent sur la performance, l’engagement des utilisateurs et l’impact global sur l’activité

  • Collaborer avec l’équipe d’ingénierie des données sur la qualité des données, la traçabilité, l’observabilité et les pipelines évolutifs ; utiliser le contrôle de version, les tests, la revue de code et des pratiques de développement reproductibles pour les actifs analytiques à forte valeur ajoutée

raw.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
raw.excerpt: ParentSquare is a rapidly growing Santa Barbara-based company that’s changing the way schools and parents communicate every day.
raw.description:
ParentSquare is a rapidly growing Santa Barbara-based company that’s changing the way schools and parents communicate every day. Sound simple? We strive to keep it that way! Our mission is to give schools the power to incredibly enhance family engagement for all students. ParentSquare and RemindHub, our flagship products, serve over 22 million students and drive our mission by providing unified communications tools -forms, sign ups, payments, RSVPs, direct messaging, language translations, chat and more. Remind Chat, our free product, reaches over 80% of K-12 students, providing a safe and easy-to-use platform for direct communication between teachers and families. And our latest innovation, SmartSites, offers state-of-the-art websites for school districts, enhancing their online presence and accessibility.

Nearly 1 in 4 students nationwide are chronically absent, making chronic absenteeism one of the highest-stakes challenges districts face. Attendance affects funding, academic outcomes, and long-term student success.

ParentSquare Attendance Plus is our answer: a proactive, relationship-driven solution built directly into the platform districts already use, giving attendance teams tiered data insights, family outreach, and intervention tracking in one place. Since launching, Attendance Plus has earned industry recognition, including Tech & Learning's Best of 2025, and has become one of the fastest-growing lines in the ParentSquare platform.

We are not just creating products; we are creating empowered educators and engaged families to improve the lives of students. We are passionate advocates for our customers and our employees, and we invite you to join us on this journey.

Who we’re looking for:

We're looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager who will own the market strategy for Attendance Plus. You'll go deep on the chronic absenteeism problem itself—the research, the district budget cycles, the competitive landscape—and use that expertise to shape where Attendance Plus goes next.

You'll own positioning and messaging for the entire attendance line, translate the needs of attendance clerks, counselors, and district administrators into a narrative that resonates through the whole buying committee, and make the call on which capabilities deserve a full go-to-market push versus a quiet rollout. You'll partner directly with the Attendance product and leadership team on packaging, pricing, and competitive strategy for the line.

Success in this role means the market understands why Attendance Plus is different, our go-to-market teams know how to win attendance conversations, and customer and competitive insights consistently shape what we build and how we take it to market. You'll be accountable not just for launches but also for helping to grow Attendance Plus as a business.

In This Role You'll:

  • Own the market strategy for Attendance Plus
    • Own positioning and messaging for Attendance Plus, translating chronic absenteeism research and district pain points into a value proposition that’s aligned internally and resonates with superintendents, student services, attendance clerks, and school boards alike.
    • Become an internal expert on the attendance and chronic absenteeism market, including state-level attendance-based funding formulas, district budget cycles, buying dynamics, emerging trends, and the competitive landscape.
    • Partner directly with the Attendance product and leadership team on pricing, packaging, and segmentation for the line, bringing the voice of the market into build and prioritization conversations.
    • Identify the highest-potential segments, use cases, and growth opportunities for Attendance Plus and develop strategies to reach them.
  • Drive go-to-market for roadmap
    • Work with GTM teams to execute plans for new Attendance Plus capabilities, determining the level of investment a release earns based on its strategic weight to the line.
    • Define launch goals and success metrics, then use adoption, customer feedback, field insights, and market response to evaluate performance and inform what comes next.
    • Turn win/loss analysis and customer research into clear insights on why we win, where we lose, and what those insights mean for our product, positioning, and go-to-market strategy.
  • Enable the field on attendance
    • Partner with Sales Enablement to help the Sales and Customer Success teams win attendance opportunities, including competitive battlecards, buyer-specific messaging, ROI and outcomes framing, and objection handling.
    • Equip Sales and Customer Success teams to confidently communicate new capabilities, positioning shifts, competitive differentiation, and responses to objections.
  • Lead proactively and drive alignment
    • Drive alignment across the Attendance product team, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and leadership, bringing stakeholders together around a shared understanding of the market and a clear narrative for how we win.
    • Surface strategic risks and opportunities early and turn those insights into clear recommendations.

Our ideal candidate will have the following:

  • Has at least 8 years of product marketing experience, with meaningful ownership of strategy, positioning, and go-to-market for a specific product or line of business.
  • A proven track record of rapidly scaling a new product line through a complex expansion motion that reaches new buyers within existing customer accounts.
  • Brings exceptional drive, high standards, and a winning mindset, with the ability to earn executive sponsorship while building adoption among frontline stakeholders.
  • Has a track record of using customer, market, and competitive insight to influence product or business decisions.
  • Has strong storytelling and written communication skills and can turn complex customer problems and product capabilities into simple, differentiated narratives.
  • Experience with win/loss analysis, customer research, and translating qualitative insight into clear recommendations.
  • Has genuine interest in the chronic absenteeism problem space and willingness to become the internal expert on it.
  • Is willing to travel to industry events and conferences to spend time with customers, prospects, and the broader education community (approximately 20% travel)

The perks of working for us are great!

You’ll get your foot in the door as our company continues to grow. We’re big believers in work-life balance and provide:

  • Employer-paid health insurance (including dependent coverage)
  • An employer-matched 401K retirement savings program from day 1
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Stock options
  • Health + wellness reimbursements
  • PTO that increases each year
  • 15 paid holidays, including your birthday!

As a fully remote team, we’ll make sure you have all the tools and equipment you need to make your home office a place where you can thrive.

We're an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. We are committed to maintaining a drug-free workplace in compliance with applicable state laws.

The salary range for this role will be $120,000-$165,000 DOE.

Position Summary:

The Senior Accounting Supervisor supports the Director of Accounting by overseeing both day‑to‑day and complex general ledger activities, coordinating key components of the monthly close, and ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of financial reporting. This role prepares and reviews advanced accounting work, resolves moderately complex accounting issues, supports acquisition and system‑related initiatives, and collaborates with auditors and tax partners. The Senior Director of Cloud Security leads the global strategy, architecture, engineering, and governance of cloud security for an enterprise operating in multi-cloud and hybrid environments. This role is accountable for securing public cloud (IaaS/PaaS), SaaS platforms, containerized workloads, and cloud-native application architectures while enabling business velocity, digital transformation, and regulatory compliance. The position partners closely with the CISO, other Information Security Sr. Leaders, and other Technology Leadership teams to establish a vision and strategy required to ensure scalable, measurable, and continuously improving defense capabilities across the applicable security domain in collaboration with other information security domain leaders and partner organizations.

Our employee experience is a strategic priority for our company. Our leaders are accountable for leading with purpose, fairness, and equity.
