Job Title: Software Engineering Manager

Location: Remote – US

Compensation: $130,000 – 160,000 + Bonus Eligible

Who we are: Lynx delivers modular, open standards–based software that transforms how high-assurance, mission-critical edge systems are built, deployed, and maintained. Our secure edge computing solutions enable innovation and operational excellence in the world’s most demanding environments, from aerospace and defense to commercial and industrial systems. We partner across industries including automotive, medical, and critical infrastructure to deliver tailored solutions aligned with each customer’s mission and operational requirements. Our key products and services are:

  • MOSA.ic: LYNX MOSA.ic™ is a modular software framework and architecture purpose-built for mission-critical edge computing. Based on the Modular Open Systems Approach (MOSA), it provides a flexible foundation for building secure, scalable, and certifiable edge systems.
  • LYNX MOSA.ic.AI: LYNX MOSA.ic.AI is a unified CPU and GPU software platform that enables deterministic, certifiable deployment of AI and advanced workloads in mission-critical edge systems. It brings control, performance, and lifecycle governance together, allowing AI to operate predictably within safety-critical environments without compromising certification or system integrity.
  • CoreSuite 2.0: CoreSuite 2.0 is Lynx’s safety-critical GPU for graphics enablement framework designed for mission-critical edge computing systems. It provides hardware-accelerated graphics, visualization, and video processing capabilities that can be certified for high-assurance systems.
  • Services: Lynx Services is Lynx’s professional services organization that helps customers design, integrate, certify, deploy, and maintain safety- and security-critical systems. It supports industries like aerospace, defense, automotive, and industrial computing through consulting, engineering, integration, and lifecycle support, reducing development risk and accelerating certification in standards-driven, mission-critical environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership: Direct and mentor a cross-functional team of software engineers and contractors. You are responsible for career growth, performance management, and resource allocation.
  • Project Execution: Own the delivery lifecycle for OS features. You’ll manage timelines, risks, and dependencies, ensuring that "moving fast" never comes at the expense of "moving safely."
  • Stakeholder Requirements: Act as the primary technical interface with external customers and internal stakeholders to capture, analyze, and refine operational capabilities into structured, actionable systems and software requirements.
  • Regulatory & Airworthiness Compliance: Deep-dive into complex aerospace and safety-critical technical standards to translate rigorous certification requirements into clear, executable engineering actionable items.

Requirements:

  • 7+ years in software engineering, with at least 3 years in a management role.
  • The ability to translate complex technical hurdles into clear project status updates for stakeholders.
  • Deep expertise in SCRUM/Agile. You know how to make Agile work in environments where "breaking things" isn't an option.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field preferred.
  • Must be a US Citizen.

Highly desired additional experience:

  • Exposure to safety-critical development processes (DO-178C, ISO 26262).
  • Experience developing systems-level software, including virtualization, OS kernels, or hypervisors for x86/ARM.

Sound Exciting? Get in touch today! We have very robust benefits including:

  • Low-cost Medical / Dental / Vision coverage options
  • 401K with generous employer match
  • Responsible Paid Time Off + Paid Holidays
  • Remote work opportunities based on role
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Career growth and professional development opportunities

raw.description:
🤙🏼 About gaiia

At gaiia, we're building the leading platform for Communications Service Providers (CSPs) that truly care about their customers. Our core product is an operating system (OS) for telcos that manages billing, operations, automation and everything in between.

We're passionate about taking care of our people, and it's not just lip service. We want you to focus on your job while we care for everything else. We offer competitive pay and benefits, attractive stock options, unparalleled transparency, and a 100% remote environment. We're excited to have you join us for your next career adventure!

🎭 Role & Team

We’re looking to hire a Team Lead & Full-Stack Software Developer who demonstrates extreme ownership, sharp problem-solving skills, and exceptional interpersonal abilities to join our Network squad.

You will join a team of 4 Full-Stack Developers (including you), a Product Manager and a Product Designer, dedicated to gaiia’s network modules: Network Monitoring, Incident Management, and Inventory & Fulfillment.

You will be reporting to the VP Eng. At gaiia, Team Leads spend their time between coding (50%) and responsibilities such as technical design, code reviews, and people management (50%). We aim to encourage skilled and passionate developers to continue coding while also enabling their peers to benefit from their technical and people leadership.

In the Network squad, your mission is to own how gaiia sees and controls our customers’ networks: monitoring what’s live, responding when it breaks, provisioning what’s next, and keeping inventory accurate as operators grow. Your squad sits at the boundary between gaiia and a long tail of third-party network vendors, so the quality of your integrations directly shapes how much of a customer’s operation can run on gaiia.

📽 What is your team working on?

Technically speaking, you will work in a serverless ecosystem of microservices deployed on AWS. gaiia is all-in on Typescript, with frontend, backend and infrastructure-as-code all leveraging Typescript.

As part of the Network squad, you will:

  • Build plug-and-play network monitoring and provisioning features by integrating with niche third-party tools, from OLT and CPE vendors to open-access network operators.
  • Build an incident management module that turns network alerts into a clear picture of who’s affected — and keeps their subscribers informed.
  • Model our customers’ physical networks: network sites, topology, and coverage areas.
  • Give operators a reliable source of truth for their IP address space.
  • Design a flexible inventory and fulfillment module that tracks every piece of equipment from the warehouse to the subscriber’s home.
  • Design, develop and deploy GraphQL APIs intended for both internal and external use.
  • Develop, in collaboration with talented designers, delightful interfaces.

🤝 What you’ll own as Team Lead

  • Lead, coach, and develop the developers on your squad through regular 1:1s, feedback, and formal evaluation.
  • Own the technical vision and architecture of the Network Monitoring and Inventory & Fulfillment modules.
  • Raise the bar on code quality, review standards, and engineering productivity within your squad.
  • Partner with your Product Manager on scope, sequencing, and capacity planning.
  • Collaborate with other squads, Customer Success, and the Implementation Team on network-heavy customer onboardings.
  • Participate in hiring and staffing decisions for your squad.

🎖️ Must-haves

  • You have at least five (5) years of experience in Typescript.
  • You have at least two (2) years of experience leading a team of developers.
  • You have experience with the React library.
  • You have experience with Node.js.
  • You have experience in DevOps and AWS services.
  • You are an advanced practitioner of agentic coding, with a track record of using AI to ship production-quality software.
  • You can deal with uncertainty and bring order to fuzzy challenges.
  • You have an outgoing and collaborative personality, eager to work with different stakeholders to solve complex problems.
  • You have a strong product mindset.

🪄 Nice-to-haves

  • You have experience with GraphQL.
  • You have knowledge of networking concepts.
  • You have familiarity with network & telecom technologies such as Calix, Nokia, Adtran, TP-Link, UISP, Tarana, NetBox, RADIUS.
  • You have an interest or expertise in functional programming.

💰 Salary

At gaiia, we have a transparent salary philosophy and a robust evaluation and compensation framework. It translates to a fair and impartial model where salaries are published internally, healthy discussions around compensation and performance can exist, and taboos are removed.

The salary range for this role is $130,000-$200,000.

🔆 Benefits

  • Stock Options Plan.
  • Group Insurance.
  • Telemedicine.
  • Life and Health Spending Accounts.
  • Group Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP).
  • Flexible working hours & all-remote work.

Civitech is a public benefit corporation dedicated to creating a fairer and more equitable democracy by building the tools and infrastructure needed to increase civic participation, empower Democratic candidates to win, and support the success of progressive causes. Since its founding in 2019, over 500 partners -- a range of nonprofit organizations, national political committees, and individual campaigns -- have utilized Civitech’s tools to reach tens of millions of voters to help create a more equitable and progressive democracy.
Civitech is a remote-first company hiring within our current footprint of 27 states (AL, AK, CA, CO, DC, DE, FL, GA, HI, IL, MA, MD, MN, NC, ND, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, SD, TN, TX, VA, WA, WI, WY); Civitech does have an office in Austin, TX.
It is important that our team reflects the diversity of the organizations we seek to serve. We strongly encourage women, people of color, LGBTQIA+ people, and others otherwise underrepresented in the technology sector to apply.
The Business Development Representative will be at the forefront of expanding our partner base, identifying and nurturing relationships with campaigns, organizations, unions, and government bodies that share our commitment to a more progressive and equitable democracy. Your work will directly contribute to the widespread adoption of our tools, empowering our partners to increase civic engagement and achieve electoral success.

Why Work at Civitech:

  • Medical, Vision, & Dental Insurance
  • 401(k) plan
  • Employee Stock Options
  • Employer-paid Life Insurance
  • Optional Short/Long Term Disability Insurance
  • Flexible Time Off & Paid Company Holidays

Civitech's Values:

  • We act with Integrity – At Civitech, we hold ourselves to the highest standards and value open and transparent communications with all of our stakeholders. Our rigorous approach to product design, testing, and data science leads to accurate assessments of our outcomes and challenges us to constantly improve our tools.
  • We are Changemakers – As a team, Civitech seeks to make transformational change in our democracy by eliminating obstacles meant to hamper contribution from every member of the community.
  • We are Collaborators - Buoyed by our mission, we look for opportunities to partner with everyone committed to making democracy easier to participate in. We seek to understand the challenges our partners face and use our skills and creativity to help them solve them.
  • We are Bold – We recognize that disruptive change won’t come with doing business as usual. Civitech seeks to revolutionize civic participation by bringing innovation and creativity to politics.

What You Will Do:

  • As a Business Development Representative, you will be a key driver of Civitech's growth and impact. You will be responsible for identifying, connecting with, and qualifying potential partners who can benefit from our suite of tools to advance their progressive missions, grow their base, and better connect with their constituents and communities.
    • Prospecting and Lead Generation:
  • Proactively identify and research potential partners, including Democratic campaigns, progressive organizations, unions, non-profits, and political committees, who align with Civitech's mission.
  • Utilize a multi-channel outreach strategy, including cold emailing, social media engagement, and phone calls to initiate contact and generate interest.
  • Build and maintain targeted prospect lists, ensuring data accuracy within our CRM system (HubSpot).
  • Stay informed about the political landscape, election cycles, and key issues to identify timely opportunities for engagement.
    • Outreach and Qualification:
  • Clearly and compellingly articulate Civitech's value proposition, demonstrating a deep understanding of our offerings and the ideal personas for adoption.
  • Conduct initial discovery calls with prospective partners to understand their needs, goals, and challenges.
  • Qualify leads based on established criteria to determine if they are a good fit for Civitech’s services and prepare them for the next steps in the sales pipeline.
    • Relationship Building and Pipeline Management:
  • Schedule and coordinate meetings and product demonstrations between qualified prospects and the sales team.
  • Nurture early-stage relationships, providing relevant information and resources to build trust and maintain engagement.
  • Meticulously track all outreach, communication, and lead status in the CRM to ensure a healthy and organized sales pipeline.
    • Strategy and Collaboration:
  • Collaborate closely with the VP of Sales and sales team to develop and refine outreach strategies, messaging, and campaign tactics.
  • Provide feedback to the sales and marketing teams on market response, lead quality, and campaign effectiveness.
  • Work with the broader Civitech team to stay up-to-date on new product features and capabilities

About You:

  • Committed to leveraging technology and data products to help Democratic candidates run for office and win, empower progressive causes, and increase civic participation.
  • You have 1-3 years of relevant experience in a business development, sales development, or a similar client-facing role, with demonstrated ability in the following areas:
    • Prospecting & Lead Generation:
  • Hands-on experience identifying and researching potential partners in a targeted, methodical way.
    • Multi-Channel Outreach:
  • Proven success using a combination of email, phone calls, and social media to initiate contact and generate interest.
    • Lead Qualification:
  • Skill in conducting initial discovery conversations to understand partner needs and determine if there is a strong potential for partnership.
    • Pipeline Management:
  • Proficiency in using a CRM (like Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar) to track activities and manage a pipeline of prospective partners.

Additional Qualifications (Desired, Not Required):

  • We know that great candidates can come from a variety of backgrounds, and we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification on this list:
  • Experience working or volunteering on a political campaign, for a nonprofit, or within a progressive advocacy organization.
  • Familiarity with the political and civic technology landscape, including a general understanding of voter data and its applications.
  • Prior experience in a high-growth SaaS (Software as a Service) or technology startup environment.
  • Proven ability to thrive and stay self-motivated in a remote-first work environment.
About our Sales Team:The Sales team at Civitech is a dynamic and mission-driven group dedicated to empowering Democratic candidates and progressive causes across the country. We are responsible for building and maintaining relationships with our partners, understanding their needs, and connecting them with the Civitech tools and data that will best support their goals. As a collaborative unit, we are passionate about expanding our reach and ensuring that our innovative solutions are accessible to the organizations working to create a more just and representative democracy.
The Business Development Representative is on our Sales team, and reports to our VP of Sales. The Business Development Representative is an individual contributor.
Civitech is headquartered in Austin, TX, with employees in various states across the country. The Business Development Representative can work from our Austin co-working space or remotely in any of the 27 states currently in Civitech’s footprint (AL, AK, CA, CO, DC, DE, FL, GA, HI, IL, MA, MD, MN, NC, ND, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, SD, TN, TX, VA, WA, WI, WY).

Job Description:

Role overview

Baker Tilly is seeking a senior consulting leader with deep applied AI expertise to define and lead the next phase of AI activation across our national consulting business. The firm has already established enterprise AI infrastructure and completed significant use-case identification. The opportunity now is to translate that foundation into a clear vision, an actionable portfolio of priorities, and measurable changes in how consulting services are delivered.

This is a business leadership role—not ownership of the underlying AI technology platform or technical delivery organization. The Director must bring enough technical depth to engage credibly with architects, engineers, data professionals, security teams, and platform owners; critically evaluate proposed approaches; challenge assumptions, estimates, constraints, and tradeoffs; and direct technical requests toward the business outcomes Consulting requires. The role will partner closely with the team responsible for OpenAI Enterprise (Anthropic and other tools in consideration), ensuring that technical decisions reflect real consulting workflows, economics, priorities, and adoption needs.

The successful candidate will combine consulting-business fluency, deep applied understanding of modern AI, strategic vision, commercial acumen, rigorous critical thinking, and strong executive influence. They will help practice leaders distinguish meaningful advances from market noise, envision new delivery models, understand revenue and margin implications, and prepare the consulting workforce for sustained change. They must also be comfortable constructively challenging technical teams when recommendations are insufficiently grounded in business value, user needs, practicality, or scale.

Key responsibilities

Set the vision and activation strategy

  • Define and communicate a compelling vision for how AI should reshape Baker Tilly Consulting over the near, medium, and longer term.

  • Translate firm strategy, market developments, and identified use cases into a prioritized Consulting AI roadmap with clear sequencing, dependencies, investment needs, and success measures.

  • Advise consulting executives and practice leaders on where to experiment, scale, pause, or redirect effort based on business value, feasibility, risk, and organizational readiness.

  • Maintain a strong external perspective on advances in generative AI, agentic systems, knowledge technologies, and emerging delivery models, separating durable signals from short-lived hype.

Reimagine consulting services and economics

  • Partner with practice leaders and subject-matter experts to redesign service delivery, workflows, team structures, and client-value propositions around AI-enabled ways of working.

  • Identify opportunities beyond labor efficiency, including improved quality and consistency, just-in-time staff training, stronger knowledge retention and dissemination, accelerated onboarding, enhanced judgment, and scalable access to expertise.

  • Evaluate the implications of AI-enabled delivery for pricing, revenue growth, capacity, utilization, leverage models, profitability, intellectual property, and competitive differentiation.

  • Develop business cases and decision frameworks that connect AI investments to measurable service-line and firm outcomes.

  • Help convert high-value concepts into repeatable methods, accelerators, playbooks, and operating capabilities that can be adopted across practices.

Direct business-to-technology translation and challenge

  • Serve as the primary Consulting business counterpart to the teams that manage enterprise AI platforms, data, integrations, security, architecture, and technical delivery.

  • Convert consulting opportunities into clear, well-structured technical and capability requests, including business requirements, workflow context, priorities, use cases, data needs, integration needs, adoption expectations, constraints, and measurable outcomes.

  • Apply sufficient technical depth to assess proposed architectures and delivery approaches, ask incisive questions, surface hidden assumptions, evaluate tradeoffs, and challenge recommendations that do not adequately address consulting-business needs.

  • Hold technology partners accountable for translating technical possibilities and limitations into clear business implications, options, risks, costs, dependencies, and decisions.

  • Coordinate with technology, innovation, risk, legal, information security, learning, and other enterprise functions to advance initiatives with appropriate controls and accountability.

Drive adoption and workforce readiness

  • Align the Consulting AI strategy with the firm’s broader workforce upskilling, learning, talent, and change strategies.

  • Define role-based AI capability expectations for consulting professionals, managers, leaders, specialists, and AI champions.

  • Guide the development of practical enablement approaches, including embedded learning, workflow-based training, communities of practice, reusable knowledge assets, office hours, and leader communications.

  • Build and mobilize a network of practice leaders, implementation leads, power users, and advocates who can translate the strategy into local action.

  • Promote responsible experimentation while reinforcing appropriate human review, professional judgment, confidentiality, quality, and risk management.

Create operating discipline and measurable progress

  • Establish a practical intake, prioritization, pilot, measurement, and scale process for Consulting AI initiatives.

  • Define scorecards and KPIs that measure adoption, service-delivery impact, quality, workforce capability, revenue contribution, margin effects, and progress from pilot to scaled use.

  • Provide clear, decision-oriented updates to Consulting leadership on progress, barriers, risks, investment needs, and business outcomes.

  • Capture lessons learned and success stories, and use them to accelerate adoption across service lines without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

Leadership profile

  • Visionary but pragmatic: able to imagine materially different ways of delivering consulting services and convert them into executable priorities.

  • Commercially minded: understands how professional services generate revenue and profit, and how changes in effort, leverage, pricing, quality, and speed affect economics.

  • AI-fluent and technically credible: possesses deep applied knowledge of generative AI, agents, retrieval, data, integrations, model capabilities, limitations, and responsible deployment practices—sufficient to engage technical specialists, evaluate proposed solutions, and challenge weak reasoning without serving as the technical delivery owner.

  • Business-to-technology director: can turn business strategy and consulting workflows into precise technical requests, define the outcomes and constraints that matter, and ensure technical teams remain aligned to commercial and operational value.

  • Critical and independent thinker: tests assumptions, probes recommendations, compares alternatives, recognizes unsupported claims, and makes sound decisions when technical and business perspectives diverge.

  • Influential and collaborative: builds trust with executives, practice leaders, practitioners, technologists, and control functions across a complex national firm.

  • Disciplined and discerning: applies sound judgment to balance speed, innovation, professional standards, risk, and long-term scalability.

  • Change-oriented: understands that sustainable AI activation requires shifts in behavior, skills, roles, incentives, and operating models—not merely access to tools.

What success looks like

  • Consulting leaders share and act on a clear, credible vision for AI-enabled service delivery.

  • A focused portfolio of priority initiatives moves from identified opportunity to adoption and scale.

  • AI capability and technical delivery requests are precise, outcome-oriented, appropriately challenged, and aligned with Consulting priorities and enterprise platform strategy.

  • Practices demonstrate measurable improvements in quality, speed, knowledge reuse, workforce readiness, revenue potential, and/or profit margin.

  • Consulting professionals have practical, role-relevant ways to build AI capability and apply it responsibly in their work.

  • Baker Tilly strengthens its competitive position by using AI to enhance expertise, judgment, client value, and scalability—not merely reduce effort.

Role scope and relationships

  • Internal, non-client-facing leadership role supporting the national Consulting business.

  • Works closely with Consulting executive leadership, practice leaders, AI implementation leads, Innovation, Applied AI/technology teams, Learning & Development, Talent, Legal, Risk, Information Security, and other enterprise functions.

  • Does not own enterprise AI infrastructure, architecture, engineering, or technical operations; owns the Consulting business vision, activation agenda, prioritization, business requirements, and value realization—and provides informed direction and challenge to the technology owners.

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree or relevant professional credential preferred.

  • 12+ years of experience in consulting, professional services, AI-enabled transformation, digital strategy, operating-model design, or a closely related field.

  • Demonstrated experience applying AI to redesign business processes, knowledge work, service delivery, or professional workflows—not solely managing technology implementation.

  • Strong understanding of consulting or professional-services economics, including pricing, utilization, leverage, capacity, revenue growth, and profitability.

  • Proven ability to develop strategy, build business cases, prioritize a portfolio of opportunities, and move initiatives from concept through adoption and scale.

  • Deep working knowledge of modern AI technologies and solution patterns, including generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, agents, data and integration requirements, model limitations, evaluation, security, and human oversight.

  • Demonstrated ability to engage architects, engineers, data professionals, and platform teams; frame effective technical requests; evaluate proposed approaches and estimates; identify gaps or weak assumptions; and constructively challenge technical recommendations.

  • Exceptional critical-thinking and decision-making skills, including the ability to synthesize incomplete information, assess competing alternatives, distinguish genuine constraints from organizational preferences, and connect technical choices to business consequences.

  • Executive-level communication, facilitation, and stakeholder-influence skills, including the ability to communicate complex AI and technology concepts in practical business terms.

  • Experience partnering across business, technology, risk, legal, security, learning, and change-management functions.

  • Strong judgment regarding responsible AI, data sensitivity, client confidentiality, intellectual property, human review, and quality control.

Preferred qualifications

  • Leadership experience within a large, multi-service consulting or professional-services organization.

  • Demonstrated experience with enterprise generative AI platforms such as OpenAI Enterprise, (Anthropic and other tools in consideration), custom GPTs, AI agents, knowledge retrieval, workflow automation, or related capabilities.

  • Experience creating or scaling AI-enabled offerings, delivery methods, accelerators, centers of excellence, champion networks, or enterprise adoption programs.

  • Experience leading broad workforce enablement, knowledge-management, or capability-building initiatives.

  • A visible body of applied work, measurable outcomes, or thought leadership demonstrating the ability to turn AI possibilities into sustained business value.

The pay rate range for this job position is $214,100 to $405,900. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of relevant factors including but not limited to applicant’s skills, prior experience, qualifications, degrees, professional certifications, work arrangements and geographic location.   • Strong clinical judgment and attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, remote environment
  • Strong documentation practices and understanding of compliance standards
  • Proficiency with technology and telehealth platforms

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Clinical Compliance

  • 100% compliance with state medical clearance regulations
  • Accurate and complete clinical documentation for all telehealth evaluations

Operational Timeliness

  • Telehealth evaluations completed within defined service timeframes
  • Minimal delays impacting clinic treatment schedules

Coverage Reliability

  • Consistent availability during scheduled coverage hours
  • Reliable support for SEV locations

Clinical Quality

  • Clear documentation of client eligibility determinations
  • Appropriate escalation of complex or high-risk cases
  • Timely clinical response, documentation, and follow-up for adverse event cases, with effective collaboration with Client Relations and Clinical Operations to support positive client outcomes.

By ensuring each client is evaluated safely and compliantly prior to treatment, Telehealth Providers support the operational consistency, regulatory integrity, and client safety standards that enable SEV to scale its national platform responsibly.

Job Overview:

We’re hiring a Pre-Sales Specialist to build and run the outbound engine behind Datakrew’s global growth. You will own a continuous, multi-geography pipeline engine and the qualification discipline that turns what it generates into genuine opportunities, supporting field sales across the UK, Europe, and Southeast Asia as the team grows. This is currently a single position, and the scope is designed to expand as the field sales team expands. You will be the connective tissue between marketing, field sales, customers, and the technical team, keeping a healthy, self-sustaining pipeline running in every market, not just the ones getting hands-on attention this week.

Own the outbound engine that builds Datakrew’s pipeline across the UK, Europe, and Southeast Asia.

Key Responsibilities:

What will you own from Day 1

  • Own and operate the automated, multi-geography cold outbound engine that builds and sustains pipeline continuously across regions, replacing one-to-one manual outreach with a repeatable, always-on system.
  • Qualify leads into genuine Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) by applying consistent qualification criteria before handing opportunities to field sales.
  • Partner with the Digital Marketing / Marketing Execution function to keep ownership clean: Marketing owns inbound demand-gen and MQL campaigns; this role owns targeted, account-level outbound and qualification into SQL.
  • Maintain CRM and outbound-tooling hygiene with accurate, up-to-date activity, account intelligence, and qualification data
  • Track and report pipeline generation volume, MQL→SQL conversion, and deal velocity across all supported regions.

What this role grows into

As the field sales team expands across regions, the scope of this role expands with it. These become part of the remit as the pipeline engine matures and beds in:

  • Deep account intelligence (buying-committee mapping, competitive positioning, use-case fit) so field sales can run a consultative, insight-led process rather than a generic pitch
  • Techno-commercial proposals tailored to client needs, decision criteria, and business objectives
  • Coordination across customers, field sales, and engineering, with quick-turnaround customisation of proposals and decks as deals progress
  • Continuous learning of Datakrew’s evolving technology and product offerings

Required skills:

  • ​​5–7 years in B2B pre-sales, inside sales, or demand generation, including at least 2 years hands-on building and running automated outbound campaigns. SaaS experience is a plus, not a requirement. Experience in EV, automotive, or battery tech is a strong plus.
  • Depth in multi-channel outbound (email and LinkedIn) using email automation and CRM platforms (e.g., HubSpot, Zoho), covering list building, cadence design, copy testing, and deliverability. This is core to the role, not incidental.
  • Aptitude for account research and building actionable account intelligence (buying committee, competitive landscape, use-case fit). Depth here can be developed in the role.
  • Strong qualification discipline, able to apply consistent criteria to convert leads into genuine SQLs rather than pass volume downstream.
  • Working knowledge of software integration concepts, APIs, and hardware-software integration.
  • Strong techno-commercial acumen, able to translate technical concepts into business language and vice versa.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication, with cultural adaptability across geographies (UK, Europe, Southeast Asia).
  • Comfort with outbound copywriting and A/B testing of messaging and cadence to improve response rates.
  • Ability to build repeatable process, this role's remit is designed to grow in scope alongside field sales as the team expands, so process discipline matters as much as individual execution
  • High ownership, quick learning, and comfort working independently in a fast-paced, cross-functional, multi-geography environment.

Good to have:

  • Prior experience engaging with EV OEMs, automotive fleets, or IoT platforms
  • Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Zoho, Pipedrive, Salesforce) and data enrichment / prospecting tools(e.g., Apollo, ZoomInfo, Clearbit).
  • Awareness of email deliverability best practices (domain warm-up, SPF/DKIM/DMARC basics) and outreach compliance considerations (GDPR, CAN-SPAM) across regions, since this role's outbound engine spans UK/Europe and Asia.
  • Exposure to AI-driven analytics or SaaS-based platforms.

Why Join Us:

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • Direct, visible impact on strategic accounts and global growth, this role sits at the centre of the GTM engine, not on its edge.
  • Learning, advancement, and leadership opportunities within a cutting-edge AI + IoT company.
  • Flexible work setup and autonomy in execution.

About Datakrew

Datakrew is revolutionizing EV fleet intelligence with cutting-edge IoT/AI solutions. Our flagship solution, OXRED Platform Suite, provides deep insights into vehicle fleet performance and diagnostics. Datakrew is backed by leading global investors including Beenext and SG Growth Capital,we serve customers across 8+ countries in Asia, including Thailand, Malaysia, Vietnam, and India, and are now expanding into the UK and Europe. Our goal is to serve one million EVs within the next 5 years, and as a company, touch a billion lives with technology.

Partners with CIO, CISO, and enterprise technology leaders to align security architecture, secure engineering practices, and cybersecurity platform investments with business priorities, regulatory requirements, and the evolving threat landscape. Fundamentally, this role is accountable both for influencing how the enterprise builds technology securely and for delivering the security platforms and services that enable Cybersecurity to protect the company at speed and scale.

Security Architecture & Engineering Leadership

  • Lead Security Architecture & Engineering as an enterprise capability, that advances secure-by-design technology practices and delivers cybersecurity engineering capabilities that protect the enterprise.

  • Establish and govern security architecture standards, reference architectures, and design patterns across applications, cloud, infrastructure, and platform services.

  • Ensure security is embedded early and consistently across the technology delivery lifecycle through secure-by-design and DevSecOps practices.

Cybersecurity Platform Engineering & Delivery

  • Own the strategy, architecture, roadmap, modernization, and delivery of core cybersecurity platforms and services that enable enterprise security operations, reduce complexity, and improve risk outcomes.

Cloud & Platform Security

  • Lead the development of guardrails and controls that enable speed while enforcing security and compliance requirements.

AI, Emerging Technology & Innovation

Strategy, Transformation & Talent

  • Build and mentor leadership talent within the organization, ensuring succession depth and strong engagement.

  • Foster a culture that balances strong risk management with business enablement and innovation.

  • Proven experience leading enterprise-level security architecture, secure engineering, and cybersecurity platform delivery functions within complex, regulated environments.

  • Deep expertise across: Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, hybrid architectures); Security architecture frameworks (NIST, ISO, CIS, etc.); Application, infrastructure, identity, and data security domains.

  • Familiarity with AI/ML security considerations, data protection, and emerging technology risk management.
